data/1/entries/2/entries/4/entries/1.english: While the two sides were negotiating in {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair, the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} suddenly disappeared from where {@creature Xanathar|WDH} had hidden it. The paranoid beholder accused the Black Network of stealing it and slew the Zhentarim envoys who were present. When the Zhents retaliated by attacking Xanathar Guild outposts, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} took their actions as confirmation of the Black Network's vile intentions. Now the bad blood between the Zhentarim and {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has begun to spill into the streets, threatening peace throughout the city.
data/1/entries/2/entries/4/entries/1.zh_tw: 當雙方在{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴中進行談判時，{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}突然從{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}藏匿它的地方消失了。這個多疑的眼魔指責黑網偷走了它，並殺死了在場的散塔林會使者。當散塔林會透過襲擊贊納塔行會的據點進行報復時，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}將他們的行為視為黑網邪惡意圖的確認。如今，散塔林會與{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}之間的仇恨已經開始蔓延到街頭，威脅著整個城市的和平。
data/1/entries/2/entries/4/entries/1.reason: beholder incorrectly called a mind flayer

data/1/entries/3/entries/5/entries/0.english: Victoro and {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH} are Waterdavian nobles and secret devil worshipers. The Cassalanters plan to use the cache of dragons to buy back the souls of their children, which they traded to Asmodeus for power. Their estate, Cassalanter Villa, has a temple of Asmodeus hidden underneath it, as described in chapter 6.
data/1/entries/3/entries/5/entries/0.zh_tw: 維克托羅和{@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH|阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特}是深水城的貴族，也是秘密崇拜魔鬼的人。卡薩蘭特家族計劃使用龍幣寶藏來贖回他們孩子的魂魄，他們曾將孩子們的魂魄交易給阿斯蒙蒂斯以換取力量。他們的莊園，卡薩蘭特別墅，下面隱藏著一個阿斯蒙蒂斯的神廟，如第6章所述。
data/1/entries/3/entries/5/entries/0.reason: dragons are gold coins in the hoard; preserves earlier correction

data/2/entries/3/entries/3/entries/3.english: Volo gives each character a small pouch containing 10 gp simply for accepting his quest. Characters who want to discover his intentions must make a {@dc 10} Wisdom (Insight) check. On a success, a character discerns that Volo is honest but might be stretching the truth about how much he can pay. (Currently low on cash, Volo is awaiting royalty payments from {@book Volo's Guide to Monsters|vgm}. To make more coin, he began work on a new book, {@i Volo's Guide to Spirits and Specters}. As it happens, his knowledge of spirits mostly concerns the alcoholic variety, and the writing has not been going well.) If pressed, Volo urges the characters to trust him, and promises he'll have the rest of the reward, 100 gp per character, ready to deliver once Floon is returned to him alive.
data/2/entries/3/entries/3/entries/3.zh_tw: 沃羅為每位接受了任務的角色提供一個小袋子，裡面裝有10金幣。想要了解他意圖的角色必須進行一次{@dc 10}的感知（洞悉）檢定。成功的角色會察覺到沃羅是誠實的，但可能誇大了他能支付的金額。（目前現金緊缺的沃羅正在等待他《沃羅的怪物指南》（{@book 瓦羅怪物指南|vgm}）的版稅收入。為了賺更多的錢，他開始著手寫一本新書，{@i 沃洛的鬼魂與幽靈指南}。事實上，他對"精神"的瞭解大多與酒精有關，寫作進展並不順利。）如果被逼問，沃羅會敦促角色們相信他，並承諾一旦弗倫活著歸還給他，他將準備好發放剩餘的獎勵，每位角色100金幣。

data/2/entries/3/entries/4/entries/4/ent.english: A cloud of lavender-scented purple smoke trails out of the shop's door as you peer inside. Every wall is painted purple, and every dusty knickknack on the shelves is dyed a deep violet. The hairless old gnome sitting cross-legged on the counter wears plum-colored robes. His cheeks are decorated with nine purple face-painted eyes.
data/2/entries/3/entries/4/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 當你窺視店內時，一陣薰衣草香氣的紫色煙霧從店門飄出。每面牆都被漆成紫色，架子上每件落滿灰塵的小飾品都被染成深紫羅蘭色。那位盤腿坐在櫃檯上的無毛老侏儒穿著梅子色的長袍，臉頰上畫著九隻紫色的眼睛圖案。

data/2/entries/3/entries/4/entries/4/ent.english: The gnome sells an assortment of trinkets. As the characters search the shelves, roll on the {@item Trinket|phb|Trinkets} table in chapter 5 of the {@book Player's Handbook|phb} to determine what catches their eye. Xoblob sells any trinket for {@dice 1d6} gp.
data/2/entries/3/entries/4/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 侏儒出售各種小玩意兒。當角色們在貨架上搜尋時，請參考{@book 玩家手冊|phb}第五章中的{@item Trinket|phb|飾品}表進行擲骰，以確定吸引他們目光的物品。索布洛布以{@dice 1d6}金幣的價格出售任何小飾品。

data/2/entries/3/entries/4/entries/4/ent.english: The gnome doesn't know Floon by name, but he recognizes his description. He is reluctant to share information, but offering him a new purple item or succeeding on a {@dc 13} Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check loosens his tongue. He says that Floon and a well-dressed fellow of similar appearance and bearing ({@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh}, though the gnome doesn't know his name and didn't recognize him) were jumped outside the shop by rough-looking men in black leather armor. Xoblob thinks there were five attackers, but none of them looked familiar. One of them had a black tattoo of a winged snake on his neck.
data/2/entries/3/entries/4/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 這個侏儒不知道福盧恩的名字，但他認出了他的描述。他不願分享資訊，但給他一個新的紫色物品或在{@dc 13}魅力（威嚇或說服）檢定中成功可以讓他開口。他說福盧恩和一個穿著考究、外表和舉止相似的人（{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}，儘管侏儒不知道他的名字，也沒有認出他）在店外被穿著黑色皮甲的粗魯男子襲擊了。索布洛布認為有五名襲擊者，但他們都不熟悉。其中一個人的脖子上有一個帶翅膀的蛇的黑色紋身。
data/2/entries/3/entries/4/entries/4/ent.reason: gnome incorrectly called a goblin; skill terminology: Intimidation

data/2/entries/4/entries/7/entries/0.english: This room is hidden behind a secret door that can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. When the secret door is opened, the characters can hear the faint sound of a bell ringing in the offices above them ({@area Z5|06e}).
data/2/entries/4/entries/7/entries/0.zh_tw: 這個房間隱藏在一扇秘密門後，可以透過成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定發現。當秘密門被開啟時，角色們可以聽到上方辦公室裡微弱的鐘聲 ({@area Z5|06e})。

data/2/entries/8/entries/3/entries/0.english: A secret door in the wall of the tunnel that leads south can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check.
data/2/entries/8/entries/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 在隧道南牆的一扇暗門可以透過成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定被發現。

data/2/entries/15/entries/0.english: This room looks empty, but a thorough search accompanied by a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom (Perception) check reveals a rough-hewn tunnel hidden beneath a loose flagstone. The low tunnel leads north to {@area Q9|086}.
data/2/entries/15/entries/0.zh_tw: 這個房間看起來是空的，但經過徹底的搜查，並結合一次成功的 {@dc 10} 感知（感知）檢定，可以發現一塊鬆動的石板下隱藏著一個粗鑿的隧道。這個低矮的隧道向北通向了 {@area Q9|086}。

data/3/entries/4/entries/4/entries/2/ent.english: Jarlaxle has written an exposé on devil worship among unnamed Waterdavian noble families. The story mentions orgies and secret deals happening behind closed doors. (Jarlaxle never passes up a chance to rattle the nobility and sow political unrest.) A character can break into Gaxly's office while it's closed, either during lunch hour or after hours. Getting in and out without being seen requires two successful {@dc 15} Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and getting past a locked door requires a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check using thieves' tools (or a {@spell knock} spell or similar magic). {@i Reward}: Each Bregan D'aerthe character gains 1 renown.
data/3/entries/4/entries/4/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 賈拉索撰寫了一篇揭露未具名的深水城貴族家族中魔鬼崇拜的報道。故事中提到了一些關起門來進行的狂歡和秘密交易。（賈拉索從不錯過任何動搖貴族和政治動盪的機會。）一個角色可以在加克斯利的辦公室關閉時闖入，要麼在午餐時間，要麼在營業時間後。進出而不被發現需要進行兩次成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷（隱匿）檢定，透過一扇鎖上的門需要使用盜賊工具進行一次成功的 {@dc 10} 敏捷檢定（或者使用 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 咒語或類似魔法）。{@i 獎勵}：每個布勒根·達爾特成員獲得 1 點聲望。

data/3/entries/4/entries/5/entries/4/ent.english: "Outlying farms are being terrorized by a scarecrow come to life. It has slaughtered livestock, chased horses, and spooked farmers. No people have been killed as yet, so the City Guard is dragging its heels. Something must be done!"
data/3/entries/4/entries/5/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: "郊外的農場正遭受一個活過來的稻草人的恐嚇。它已經屠殺了牲畜，追逐馬匹，嚇壞了農民。到目前為止還沒有人被殺，所以城防軍隊還在拖延。必須採取行動！"
data/3/entries/4/entries/5/entries/4/ent.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/3/entries/4/entries/5/entries/4/ent.english: "Sir Ambrose Everdawn, a grizzled old champion of Kelemvor, has offered to help the City Guard catch a necromancer who's stealing bones from the City of the Dead and animating them as skeletons. Sir Ambrose could use your help, if you're not too busy."
data/3/entries/4/entries/5/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: "安布羅斯·永曉爵士，一位經驗豐富的凱蘭沃老冠軍，提出幫助城防軍捉拿一個從死者之城偷骨頭並將其製成骷髏的死靈法師。如果你不太忙的話，安布羅斯爵士可以利用你的幫助。"
data/3/entries/4/entries/5/entries/4/ent.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/3/entries/4/entries/5/entries/4/ent.english: The characters need to confront "{@creature Bonnie|WDH}" the {@creature doppelganger} and, with a successful {@dc 15} Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check, convince her to leave Waterdeep and take her gang with her. {@i Reward}: Each Emerald Enclave character gains 2 renown.
data/3/entries/4/entries/5/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 角色們需要面對 {@creature Bonnie|WDH|邦妮} 這個 {@creature doppelganger||變形怪}，並透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（威嚇或說服）檢定，說服她離開深水城並帶走她的幫派。{@i 獎勵}：每個翠綠閒庭角色的聲望增加2。

data/3/entries/4/entries/5/entries/4/ent.english: Locating the grell requires a successful {@dc 18} Intelligence (Investigation) check followed by a successful {@dc 18} Wisdom (Survival) check. Each check, whether successful or not, represents 1 hour of gathering information or tracking spoor. In fact, there are two {@creature grell||grells}. One grell tries to flee if the other is killed. {@i Reward}: Each Emerald Enclave character gains 2 renown. Jeryth bestows a charm of heroism (see "Supernatural Gifts" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}) on each party member who helped slay the grells.
data/3/entries/4/entries/5/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 定位格雷爾需要成功的 {@dc 18} 智力（調查）檢定，隨後是成功的 {@dc 18} 感知（求生）檢定。無論是否成功，每次檢定都代表了1小時的資訊收集或追蹤蹤跡。實際上，有兩隻 {@creature grell||觸鬚怪}。如果其中一隻格雷爾被殺死，另一隻會試圖逃跑。{@i 獎勵}：每個翡翠庭院的角色獲得2點聲望。傑里斯會將英雄魅力（見《{@book 城主指南|dmg}》第7章的"超自然禮物"）賜予每個參與擊殺格雷爾的隊伍成員。
data/3/entries/4/entries/5/entries/4/ent.reason: skill terminology: Survival; Wisdom uses site attribute name 感知

data/3/entries/4/entries/6/entries/3/ent.english: Vajra gives each character a {@item potion of water breathing} to complete this mission. They find a {@creature young bronze dragon}, Zelifarn, swimming around a barnacle-covered shipwreck at the bottom of the deep harbor. The friendly dragon tries to coax as much treasure as it can from the characters. Those who converse with Zelifarn can make a {@dc 13} Wisdom (Insight) check. A successful check reveals that the dragon poses no danger to Waterdeep. If no one succeeds on the check, the dragon's true intentions can't be gleaned. {@i Reward}: Each Gray Hand character gains 1 renown.
data/3/entries/4/entries/6/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 瓦吉拉給每個角色一瓶{@item potion of water breathing||水下呼吸藥水}來完成這項任務。他們在深港底部發現一條{@creature young bronze dragon||青年青銅龍}——澤利法恩，在覆蓋著藤壺的沉船周圍遊動。這隻友好的龍試圖從角色們身上哄騙儘可能多的財寶。與澤利法恩交談的人可以嘗試進行一次{@dc 13}感知（洞悉）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色會發現這條龍對深水城沒有威脅。如果沒有人透過檢定，龍的真正意圖就無法被察覺。{@i 獎勵}: 每個灰手成員獲得1點聲望。

data/3/entries/4/entries/6/entries/3/ent.english: Characters can befriend {@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) or watch him from afar. Each day at dawn, Meloon engages in a telepathic contest of wills with his magic axe, {@item Azuredge|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}), before leaving his room at the Yawning Portal. The axe wants a new wielder, but Meloon refuses to part with it. Characters who observe Meloon during this exchange can ascertain what's going on with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Insight) check. {@i Reward}: Each Gray Hand character gains 2 renown. If the characters rid Meloon of the {@creature intellect devourer} in his skull, Vajra gives the party a {@item wand of secrets}.
data/3/entries/4/entries/6/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 角色們可以與 {@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH|麥倫·戰龍}（見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）建立友誼，或是遠遠地觀察他。每天黎明時分，梅倫都會在他位於"打呵欠的入口"的房間裡與他的魔法斧頭 {@item Azuredge|WDH|蔚藍之鋒}（見 {@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）進行一場心靈意志的較量，然後才會離開房間。斧頭想要尋找一個新的持有者，但梅倫拒絕放棄它。角色們如果在這場較量中觀察梅倫，可以透過一個成功 {@dc 15} 的感知（洞悉）檢定來瞭解發生了什麼事情。{@i 獎勵}：每個"灰手"角色的角色將獲得 2 點聲望。如果角色們能夠清除梅倫頭顱中的 {@creature intellect devourer||噬腦怪}，瓦傑拉將給予隊伍一支 {@item wand of secrets||探秘魔杖}。
data/3/entries/4/entries/6/entries/3/ent.reason: skill terminology: Insight; Wisdom uses site attribute name 感知

data/3/entries/4/entries/7/entries/3/ent.english: The characters must speak with five {@creature doppelganger||doppelgangers}, starting with their leader, "{@creature Bonnie|WDH}," who works at the Yawning Portal. She needs a few days to round up the other doppelgangers, who agree to meet at the tavern in human guises. Characters must interview each doppelganger and succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom (Insight) check to ascertain its trustworthiness. Only "{@creature Bonnie|WDH}" is trustworthy. {@i Reward}: Each Harper character gains 2 renown. Every contributing party member receives 50 gp.
data/3/entries/4/entries/7/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 角色們必須與五個{@creature doppelganger||變形怪}交談，從他們的領袖"{@creature Bonnie|WDH|邦妮}"開始，她在打哈欠之門工作。她需要幾天時間來召集其他化身怪，他們同意以人類的外表在酒館碰面。角色們必須分別採訪每個化身怪，並透過一個{@dc 16}的感知（洞悉）檢定來確定其可信度。只有"{@creature Bonnie|WDH|邦妮}"是可信的。{@i 獎勵}：每個哈珀的角色獲得2點聲望。每個參與的隊員獲得50金幣。

data/3/entries/4/entries/7/entries/3/ent.english: {@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) knows of the mission, but it's not revealed to the characters that she's a Harper. There's one drow spy in attendance: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). He uses his {@item hat of disguise} to appear as a young actor from Luskan named Erystian Demarne. A successful {@dc 24} Wisdom (Insight) check is needed to out Jarlaxle. Impressed by the perceptive adventurers, he thanks Lady Haventree for an entertaining evening and dashes off, but not without first tipping his hat to the character or characters who exposed him. {@i Reward}: Each Harper character gains 2 renown. Every party member who attended the party receives 200 gp.
data/3/entries/4/entries/7/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: {@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH|蕾米莉亞·港樹}（參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）知道這個任務，但角色們並不知道她是哈珀的一員。在場的一名卓爾間諜是{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}（參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。他使用{@item hat of disguise||易容帽}變身為一名來自路斯坎的年輕演員，名為埃里斯蒂安·德馬涅。需要成功的{@dc 24} 感知（洞悉）檢定才能揭穿賈拉索。他對這些敏銳的冒險者印象頗深，感謝哈文特里夫人提供了一個愉快的夜晚並迅速離開，但在離開前他會向揭穿他的角色或角色們脫帽致意。{@i 獎勵}：每個哈珀角色獲得2點聲望。每位參加派對的隊伍成員將獲得200金幣。

data/3/entries/4/entries/9/entries/1/ent.english: The inn is being harassed by the Shard Shunners, a gang of halfling wererats, because the innkeeper's guards once threatened a gang member. To end the harassment, the characters must defeat three {@creature wererat||wererats} or scare them off with a successful {@dc 17} Charisma (Intimidation) check. {@i Reward}: Each Order of the Gauntlet character gains 2 renown and receives a {@item potion of healing}.
data/3/entries/4/entries/9/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 這家旅館正受到"避碎幫"的騷擾，這是一個由半身人鼠人組成的幫派，因為旅館老闆的守衛曾威脅過一名幫派成員。為了結束這種騷擾，角色們必須擊敗三隻{@creature wererat||鼠人}或透過一次成功的{@dc 17}魅力（威嚇）檢定嚇跑他們。{@i 獎勵}：每位鐵手套教團角色獲得2點聲望，並收到一瓶{@item potion of healing||治療藥水}。
data/3/entries/4/entries/9/entries/1/ent.reason: source-addressed proper-noun or creature/faction consistency correction

data/3/entries/4/entries/9/entries/1/ent.english: The characters must help Savra defeat five {@creature spined devil||spined devils}, which have locals pinned down in nearby buildings. Right afterward, Gysheer Omfreys (LE female Tethyrian human {@creature cult fanatic}) emerges from an alley and attacks Savra. Gysheer is an overzealous member of a devil-worshiping cult led by {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). Savra tries to subdue and question her, but only magical compulsion can force her to implicate Victoro. Since devil worship isn't illegal in Waterdeep, Savra has no grounds to stir up trouble with the Cassalanters, and she advises characters not to do so, either. {@i Reward}: Each Order of the Gauntlet character gains 2 renown. Every character who took part receives a {@item potion of greater healing}.
data/3/entries/4/entries/9/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 角色們必須幫助薩芙拉擊敗五個{@creature spined devil||棘魔}，它們使當地居民被困在附近的建築物中。緊接著，吉希爾·奧姆弗雷斯 (LE女性泰瑟爾人人類{@creature cult fanatic||邪教狂信者})從一條小巷中出現並攻擊薩芙拉。吉希爾是由{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）領導的崇拜魔鬼的邪教的過於熱心的成員。薩芙拉試圖制服並審問她，但只有魔法強制才能迫使她揭露維克托羅。由於在深水城崇拜魔鬼並不違法，薩芙拉沒有理由與卡薩蘭特家族製造麻煩，她也建議角色們不要這樣做。{@i 獎勵}：每個戰旗秩序角色獲得2點聲望。每個參與的角色都會收到一瓶{@item potion of greater healing||高等治療藥水}。
data/3/entries/4/entries/9/entries/1/ent.reason: renown statistic terminology; preserves earlier correction

data/3/entries/4/entries/10/entries/4/en.english: Characters who spend three consecutive nights loitering around the docks spot Heldar, a drunk half-elf sailor ({@creature bandit}), leaving the Muleskull Tavern (on Ship Street in the Dock Ward). Characters who follow Heldar can save him from {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh}, a renegade {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). Soluun hides in the shadows, blade drawn, waiting for the half-elf to stumble by. Spotting him before he strikes requires a successful {@dc 18} Wisdom (Perception) check. Soluun flees if reduced to half his hit points or fewer. {@i Reward}: Each Zhentarim character gains 1 renown. If Heldar survives Soluun's attack, each character receives 50 gp.
data/3/entries/4/entries/10/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 連續三晚在碼頭附近閒逛的角色會發現一個醉醺醺的半精靈水手赫爾德（{@creature bandit||匪徒}）離開騾顱酒館（位於碼頭區的船舶街）。跟隨赫爾德的角色可以從叛徒索倫·希布林達斯（{@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh|索倫·希布林達斯}），一個叛逃的黑暗精靈槍手（{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}）手中救下他（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。索倫藏在陰影中，拔出刀刃，等待半精靈跌跌撞撞地經過。在他發動攻擊前發現他需要成功透過一次 {@dc 18} 的感知（感知）檢定。如果索倫的生命值降至一半或更低，他會逃跑。{@i 獎勵}：每個散塔林會角色獲得1點聲望。如果赫爾德在索倫的攻擊中倖存下來，每個角色將獲得50金幣。

data/4/entries/6/entries/2.english: The characters have only a few minutes to search the crime scene before members of the City Guard arrive. After that, they aren't allowed anywhere near the bodies, although {@condition invisible} and similarly hidden characters can search the crime scene further. A search of the bodies accompanied by a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check reveals the following:
data/4/entries/6/entries/2.zh_tw: 在城防軍到達之前，角色們只有幾分鐘的時間來搜查犯罪現場。之後，他們不允許靠近屍體，儘管{@condition invisible||隱形}和類似隱藏的角色可以進一步搜查犯罪現場。伴隨成功的{@dc 15} 感知 (感知) 檢定搜查屍體會發現以下內容：
data/4/entries/6/entries/2.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch; skill terminology: Perception

data/4/entries/8/entries/3/entries/3/ent.english: If the characters mention the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, Zord shrugs his shoulders in a manner that suggests he doesn't know what they're talking about. He also feigns disinterest in Waterdeep politics, saying, "Every city has problems, I suppose. My job as an entertainer is to make people forget about politics for a while." Characters who are suspicious of Zord can make a {@dc 24} Wisdom (Insight) check. Any character who succeeds on the check senses that there's much more to him than meets the eye.
data/4/entries/8/entries/3/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 如果角色們提到 {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，佐德會聳聳肩，表示他不知道他們在說什麼。他還假裝對深水城的政治不感興趣，說道："我想每個城市都有自己的問題。作為一名藝人，我的工作是讓人們暫時忘記政治。" 對佐德有疑心的角色可以進行一次 {@dc 24} 感知（洞悉）檢定。任何成功透過檢定的角色都會察覺到，他絕非表面看起來那麼簡單。

data/4/entries/8/entries/3/entries/3/ent.english: Jarlaxle owns a {@item hat of disguise} but doesn't need it to hide his true form while he's aboard any of his ships. His disguise (and the disguises of his drow subordinates) can be dispelled only by destroying the ship's figurehead (see chapter 7). If the characters somehow discern his true form, Jarlaxle gives the party a slow nod of his head, dryly says "Bravo!" and lets them make the next move.
data/4/entries/8/entries/3/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 賈拉克西擁有一頂{@item hat of disguise||易容帽}，但在他登上他的任何一艘船時，他不需要它來隱藏他的真實形態。他的偽裝（以及他的卓爾下屬的偽裝）只能透過摧毀船的船首像（見第七章）來解除。如果角色們以某種方式識破他的真實形態，賈拉克西會向隊伍慢慢地點頭，乾巴巴地說"精彩！"，然後讓他們採取下一步行動。

data/4/entries/10/entries/5/entries/2/en.english: Sneaking in or out of the villa without being seen or heard by neighbors and passersby requires each character to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity (Stealth) check. A character who has proficiency in the Stealth skill can take disadvantage on the check to grant advantage on another party member's check (essentially compensating for a less stealthy companion).
data/4/entries/10/entries/5/entries/2/en.zh_tw: 在未被鄰居和路人發現或聽到的情況下潛入或逃離別墅，每個角色都需要成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷（隱匿）檢定。擁有潛行技能熟練項的角色可以選擇在檢定中承受劣勢，以讓另一名隊友的檢定獲得優勢（本質上是為了彌補一位不太擅長隱匿的同伴）。

data/4/entries/10/entries/7/entries/3/en.english: The yard is looked after by a menacing groundskeeper named Hurv Taldred (LE male Illuskan {@creature cult fanatic}) and his two quiet {@creature mastiff||mastiffs}. The Gralhunds paid a necromancer to perform a ritual on Hurv and his mastiffs. After sundown, the physical forms of these figures melt away, and they become three {@creature shadow||shadows} until dawn. Characters who succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity (Stealth) check can cross the yard without being detected. Otherwise, Hurv and his hounds detect the characters and attack, day or night.
data/4/entries/10/entries/7/entries/3/en.zh_tw: 這個院子由一個名叫赫夫·塔爾德里德（LE男性伊路斯坎人 {@creature cult fanatic||邪教狂信者}）的威脅性看管人照看，還有他的兩隻安靜 {@creature mastiff||獒犬}。格拉倫德家族僱用了一名死靈法師對赫夫和他的獒犬進行了一個儀式。日落後，這些生物的實體形態會消失，變成三個 {@creature shadow||幽影}，直到黎明。成功透過 {@dc 13}敏捷（隱匿）檢定的人物可以穿越院子而不被察覺。否則，無論白天還是夜晚，赫夫和他的獵犬都會察覺到人物並發動攻擊。

data/4/entries/10/entries/7/entries/13/e.english: The Gralhund family crest appears on the book's title page. The rest of the book is written in Common and describes births, deaths, and other family events between 1239 DR, the Year of the Bloodied Sword, and 1422 DR, the Year of Advancing Shadows. Of particular note is the little-known fact that the Gralhunds forged pacts with devils in years past, giving rise to a strain of tieflings. All such members of the house were sent to live on a Gralhund estate in Yartar, a city far to the north (or so the book claims in its epilogue), and there are passing references to some Waterdavian family members having been born with tails.
data/4/entries/10/entries/7/entries/13/e.zh_tw: 格勞洪德家族的徽章出現在書的標題頁上。書中其餘部分用通用語寫成，描述了從1239 DR年，流血之劍年，到1422 DR年，陰影前進年之間的出生、死亡和其他家族事件。特別值得注意的是，書中鮮為人知的事實是格勞洪德家族家族在過去與魔鬼締結了契約，由此產生了一種提夫林血統。所有這樣的家族成員都被送往遠在北方的亞塔的格勞洪德莊園生活（或者書的尾聲中是這樣聲稱的），並且書中還順便提到了一些水源家族成員出生時帶有尾巴。

data/4/entries/10/entries/7/entries/16/e.english: Characters who have Lord Gralhund at their mercy can pry the following information from him with a successful {@dc 10} Charisma (Intimidation) check, but the check is made with disadvantage if Lord Gralhund has reason to believe his wife can see or overhear the conversation:
data/4/entries/10/entries/7/entries/16/e.zh_tw: 任何能夠控制格拉倫德勳爵的角色，可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 10} 魅力（威嚇）檢定從他那裡撬出以下資訊，但如果格拉倫德勳爵有理由相信他的妻子能看見或偷聽到對話，則檢定時帶有劣勢。

data/4/entries/10/entries/7/entries/17/e.english: The lock on the trunk can be picked with thieves' tools and a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check. The trunk appears to contain folded clothes and shoes. A secret compartment in the bottom can be detected by someone who examines the outside of the trunk and makes a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. The compartment holds two holy symbols of Asmodeus and two robes, each red and gold in color.
data/4/entries/10/entries/7/entries/17/e.zh_tw: 這個箱子的鎖可以用盜賊工具開啟，並且需要進行一次成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定。箱子裡面似乎裝著摺疊好的衣服和鞋子。箱底有一個隱秘的隔間，如果有檢查箱子外部的人並且進行了一次成功的{@dc 15}感知（感知）檢定，就可以發現這個隔間。隔間裡裝著兩個阿斯蒙蒂斯的神聖象徵和兩件紅金色的長袍。

data/4/entries/12/entries/1/entries/1/en.english: If the weather is fair, characters can see pedestrians, picnickers, and frolicking children throughout the cemetery grounds. It's clear that Istrid chose a safe, public place for the meeting. Characters who succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom (Insight) check can tell that she came alone.
data/4/entries/12/entries/1/entries/1/en.zh_tw: 如果天氣晴朗，角色們可以看到墓園中散步的行人、野餐的人以及嬉戲的孩子們。很明顯，伊斯特麗德選擇了一個安全的公共場所進行會面。成功透過{@dc 15}感知（洞悉）檢定的角色可以判斷出她是獨自前來。

data/5/entries/3/entries/7/entries/1/ent.english: The characters arrive at the Cassalanter mausoleum to find several dead cultists inside (encounter 4, "Mausoleum"). A left-for-dead survivor reveals that these cultists were betrayed by two of their own. The characters head to an old windmill in the Southern Ward where the cult fanatics practice their diabolical faith (encounter 10, "Converted Windmill"). Spined devils swoop in, snatch the stone, and flee, setting up a rooftop chase (encounter 5, "Rooftop Chase").
data/5/entries/3/entries/7/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 當角色們到達卡薩蘭特家族的陵墓時，發現裡面有幾個死去的邪教徒（遭遇4，'陵墓'）。一個被留下等死的生還者透露，這些邪教徒被他們自己人中的兩個背叛了。角色們前往南方區的一箇舊風車，那裡是邪教狂信者實踐他們魔鬼信仰的地方（遭遇10，'改造風車'）。棘魔突然降臨，搶走了石頭，並逃跑，引發了一場屋頂追逐（遭遇5，'屋頂追逐'）。

data/5/entries/4/entries/3/entries/2/ent.english: The characters enter the alley followed by eight {@creature kobold||kobolds} disguised as children wearing troll masks. A {@creature bugbear} named Morga and an {@creature intellect devourer} hide in a doorway halfway down the alley and can be spotted with a successful {@dc 16} Wisdom (Perception) check.
data/5/entries/4/entries/3/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 角色們進入巷子，後面跟著八名偽裝成戴著巨魔面具的孩子的 {@creature kobold||狗頭人}。一名叫做摩加 {@creature bugbear||熊地精} 的巨熊人和一隻 {@creature intellect devourer||噬腦怪} 心靈吞噬者藏在巷子中段的一個門道里，成功透過 {@dc 16} 感知（感知）檢定可以發現它們。

data/5/entries/4/entries/4/entries/1/ent.english: When he sees the characters, Willifort orders the imps and the spined devils to attack. The bearded devil stays close to Willifort and engages any character who tries to reach the hire-coach.
data/5/entries/4/entries/4/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 當威利福特看到角色們時，他命令小魔鬼和棘魔發起攻擊。長鬍子的魔鬼留在威利福特身邊，並與任何試圖接近僱傭馬車的角色交戰。

data/5/entries/4/entries/4/entries/1/ent.english: If there's any chance that the characters might obtain the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} as the encounter progresses, Willifort orders the driver to move the hire-coach out of the alley as quickly as possible. If the driver is {@condition incapacitated} or killed, the bearded devil climbs into the driver's seat on the back of the coach and steers the vehicle. If the bearded devil is unable to replace the driver, the doppelganger takes the reins. Willifort flees on foot if the hirecoach is destroyed or its horses are unable to move.
data/5/entries/4/entries/4/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 如果隨著遭遇的進行，角色們有可能獲得{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，威利福特就命令駕駛員儘快將僱傭馬車開出小巷。如果駕駛員被{@condition incapacitated||無力}或殺死，長鬍子的魔鬼會爬到馬車後部的駕駛座上並駕駛車輛。如果長鬍子的魔鬼無法替代駕駛員，變形怪將接管韁繩。如果僱傭馬車被摧毀或其馬無法移動，威利福特將步行逃跑。

data/5/entries/4/entries/5/entries/2/ent.english: The door to Fenerus's house stands open, and the place has been ransacked. Painted in blood on the kitchen wall is a circle with ten equidistant lines radiating outward from its circumference: the sign of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}. A thorough search accompanied by a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom (Perception) check reveals small pools of blood on the kitchen floor. A successful check also verifies that the blood on the floor and wall is fresh.
data/5/entries/4/entries/5/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 菲納魯斯家的門敞開著，屋內已被洗劫一空。廚房的牆上用血跡畫著一個圓圈，從圓周向外輻射出十條等距的直線：這是{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的標誌。在廚房的地板上，透過一次成功的{@dc 12}感知（感知）檢定，可以發現幾處小血跡。成功的檢定還確認了地板和牆上的血液都是新鮮的。

data/5/entries/4/entries/5/entries/4/ent.english: Characters who are suspicious of Laeral's intentions can ascertain that she's hiding something with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check contested by Jarlaxle's Charisma (Deception) check. If the characters somehow penetrate Jarlaxle's disguise, he smiles and offers them 10,000 gp if they promptly deliver the stone to him at the Seven Masks Theater. He assures them, in all honesty, that he plans to give the gold back to Waterdeep in exchange for some political goodwill.
data/5/entries/4/entries/5/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 對萊拉的意圖持懷疑態度的角色可以透過成功的感知（洞悉）檢定與賈拉克西的魅力（欺瞞）檢定進行對抗，以確定她在隱瞞一些事情。如果角色們設法看穿了賈拉克西的偽裝，他會微笑並提出如果他們立即將石頭送到七面具劇院給他，就給他們10,000金幣。他誠實地向他們保證，他計劃將黃金還給深水城以換取一些政治上的好感。
data/5/entries/4/entries/5/entries/4/ent.reason: skill terminology: Insight; skill terminology: Deception

data/5/entries/4/entries/6/entries/1.english: The characters approach from either end of the alley. Hoofprints and wheel ruts in the snow testify that Justyn Rassk's delivery cart passed through the alley recently after a brief stop outside the meat shop. A character who inspects the tracks and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom (Survival) check can tell that the deliverer visited both the shop and the alley residence. Before the characters can investigate further, they are assaulted by members of the Xanathar Guild.
data/5/entries/4/entries/6/entries/1.zh_tw: 角色們從小巷的兩端接近。雪地中的蹄印和車轍證明賈斯汀·拉斯克的送貨車在肉店外短暫停留後，最近透過了這條小巷。一個角色如果檢查這些痕跡並在{@dc 10} 感知（求生）檢定中成功，可以判斷出送貨人既去了商店也去了小巷的住所。在角色們能夠進一步調查之前，他們遭到了姍娜薩公會成員的襲擊。
data/5/entries/4/entries/6/entries/1.reason: Xanathar Guild, not Zhentarim, commits this attack

data/5/entries/6/entries/2/entries/3/ent.english: A character can use an action to search the crowded street by making a {@dc 17} Wisdom (Perception) check. On a successful check, the character spots an iron grate in the street that wasn't closed properly. Lifting it reveals an iron ladder that descends 10 feet to an underground sewer tunnel. Characters who lower themselves into the tunnel can hear the sounds of splashing water and children's voices in the distance and might decide to follow them. (The children are holding hands in the dark and being guided by {@creature Squiddly|WDH}, who has darkvision.)
data/5/entries/6/entries/2/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 一個角色可以使用一個動作在擁擠的街道上進行搜尋，進行一次 {@dc 17} 感知（感知）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色會注意到街道上一個沒有正確關閉的鐵柵欄。揭開它後，會發現一個鐵梯子向下延伸10尺，通往一個地下下水道隧道。角色們如果下到隧道里，可以聽到遠處的水花聲和孩子們的聲音，並可能決定跟隨他們。（這些孩子們在黑暗中手拉著手，由 {@creature Squiddly|WDH|斯奎迪利} 引導，它擁有黑暗視覺。）

data/5/entries/7/entries/0.english: The City of the Dead is a public park dotted with mausoleums. The place is closed at night, with two City Guard soldiers ({@creature guard||guards}) stationed at each entry gate. A character can slip over a wall undetected with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity (Stealth) check.
data/5/entries/7/entries/0.zh_tw: 死者之城是一個點綴著陵墓的公園。此地夜間關閉，每個入口大門都有兩名城市衛兵（{@creature guard||警衛}）站崗。角色若透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷（隱匿）檢定，可以不被發現地翻牆進入。

data/5/entries/7/entries/2.english: Sir Ambrose Everdawn (LG male human Tethyrian {@creature knight}), an aging servant of Kelemvor (god of the dead), patrols the cemetery from sunset to sunrise, chasing off grave robbers and making sure the dead stay buried. Characters who creep around the cemetery in the dark have a {@chance 30|30 percent chance} of running into him. If that happens, he escorts them out and alerts the City Guard if they refuse to leave.
data/5/entries/7/entries/2.zh_tw: 安布羅斯·永曉爵士 (LG男性人類泰瑟爾人 {@creature knight||騎士}), 是凱蘭沃（死者之神）的一位年邁僕人，從日落到日出巡邏墓地，驅趕盜墓賊，確保死者安息。在黑暗中潛行於墓地的角色有{@chance 30|30%的機率}遇到他。如果發生了這種情況，他會護送他們離開，並在他們拒絕離開時通知城防軍。
data/5/entries/7/entries/2.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/5/entries/7/entries/4/entries/2/ent.english: The characters can take the key to the Metal House of Wonders, the guildhall of the Splendid Order of Armorers, Locksmiths, and Finesmiths in the Dock Ward, or to any local locksmith. In either place, someone can identify the key as the handiwork of a dwarf locksmith in the Trades Ward named Elaspra Ulmarr. Characters who visit Elaspra's shop can learn from her that she made a key for a client who bought one of her excellent locks. She even installed the lock for him. Elaspra won't easily divulge the name of the client or his place of residence. She has great respect for the Harpers, however; a character who belongs to this faction and produces a Harper pin to prove it can pry the information from her with a successful {@dc 13} Charisma (Persuasion) check. A character pretending to be a Harper can fool her with a successful {@dc 16} Charisma (Deception) check.
data/5/entries/7/entries/4/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 角色們可以將鑰匙帶到'金屬奇蹟之屋'，即位於碼頭區的輝煌鎧甲工匠、鎖匠與精工師公會的大廳，或是帶到任何當地鎖匠那裡。無論在哪一處，都會有人認出這把鑰匙是由貿易區一位名叫艾拉斯普拉·烏爾瑪爾的矮人鎖匠所打造的。如果角色們訪問艾拉斯普拉的店鋪，可以從她那裡得知，她曾為一位購買了她精品鎖具的客戶打造過一把鑰匙，甚至為他安裝了鎖具。艾拉斯普拉不會輕易透露客戶的名字或住址，但她對豎琴手聯盟組織懷有極大的敬意；如果角色屬於這個組織並出示豎琴手聯盟徽章作為證明，可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 13} 魅力（說服）檢定從她那裡獲取資訊。如果角色偽裝成豎琴手聯盟成員，也可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 16} 魅力（欺瞞）檢定騙取她的信任。

data/5/entries/7/entries/4/entries/3/ent.english: If this encounter occurs at night, there's a {@chance 50|50 percent chance} that Ambrose Everdawn hears the disturbance and investigates, arriving after two duergar fall in battle. The characters can convince him that they're not grave robbers with a successful {@dc 15} Charisma (Persuasion) check. If they're polite, Ambrose escorts them out of the City of the Dead and warns them not to trespass again. Otherwise, he attempts to subdue them and turn them over to the City Guard.
data/5/entries/7/entries/4/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 如果這次遭遇發生在夜晚，有 {@chance 50|50%的機率} 安布羅斯·永晝會聽到動靜並前來調查，戰鬥中有兩名灰矮人倒下後他才會到達。角色們可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（說服）檢定來說服他他們並非盜墓者。如果他們表現得有禮貌，安布羅斯會護送他們離開死者之城，並警告他們不要再擅闖。否則，他會試圖制服他們並將他們交給城防軍。
data/5/entries/7/entries/4/entries/3/ent.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/5/entries/8/entries/2/rows/0/1.english: You come to a 10-foot-wide gap between rooftops. You can jump over the gap if your Strength is 10 or higher (each foot you clear costs 1 foot of movement), and you must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or fall {@condition prone} on the far rooftop. Or you can cross the gap using a 10-foot-long rope line that stretches between the two rooftops
data/5/entries/8/entries/2/rows/0/1.zh_tw: 你來到兩個屋頂之間一處10尺寬的缺口。如果你的力量達到10或更高，你可以跳過這個缺口（每清除1尺需要消耗1尺的移動力），並且你必須成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 敏捷（體操）檢定，否則你會在遠處的屋頂上摔倒 {@condition prone||伏地}。或者你也可以使用一條10尺長的繩索在兩屋頂之間穿越這個缺口

data/5/entries/8/entries/2/rows/6/1.english: A rooftop protuberance such as a chimney or weather vane gets in your way. Make a {@dc 10} Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. On a failed check, the obstacle counts as 5 feet of {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
data/5/entries/8/entries/2/rows/6/1.zh_tw: 一個屋頂的突出物，如煙囪或風向標，擋住了你的去路。進行一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷（體操）檢定。如果檢定失敗，該障礙物視為 5 尺的 {@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

data/5/entries/8/entries/3/entries/0.english: The characters are trying to catch up with three {@creature spined devil||spined devils} that keep low above the rooftops, so as not to be seen by Waterdeep's Griffon Cavalry. The devils are 100 feet away from the characters at the start of the chase.
data/5/entries/8/entries/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 角色們正試圖追上三個在屋頂上方低飛的{@creature spined devil||棘魔}，以免被深水城的獅鷲騎兵發現。追逐開始時，魔鬼們距離角色們100尺遠。

data/5/entries/8/entries/3/entries/1.english: If the devil carrying the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} becomes {@condition incapacitated}, another devil snatches the stone and flees with it.
data/5/entries/8/entries/3/entries/1.zh_tw: 如果攜帶{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的魔鬼變得{@condition incapacitated||無力}，另一個魔鬼會奪走石頭並帶著它逃跑。

data/5/entries/8/entries/3/entries/2/ent.english: When the characters are close to getting the stone, or when you want the chase to end, all remaining spined devils duck into an alley. If the characters lose their quarry, they can question city folk on the ground who saw where the devils went. Continue with encounter 1, "Alley."
data/5/entries/8/entries/3/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 當角色們接近獲得石頭時，或者當你想結束追逐時，所有剩餘的棘魔會躲進一條小巷。如果角色們失去了目標，他們可以詢問地面上的市民，瞭解魔鬼們去了哪裡。繼續進行遭遇1，"小巷"。

data/5/entries/9/entries/3/entries/3/ent.english: One of the dressing rooms ({@area P8|199}) contains a secret trapdoor in the floor that no one knows about. It can be found with a successful {@dc 20} Wisdom (Perception) check. This stone door has an {@spell arcane lock} spell cast on it and can be pulled open with a successful {@dc 30} Strength (Athletics) check. A {@spell knock} spell or similar magic also does the trick.
data/5/entries/9/entries/3/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 其中一個更衣室（{@area P8|199}）的地板上有一個沒人知道的秘密活板門。透過一次成功的{@dc 20}感知（感知）檢定可以發現它。這塊石門被施放了{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術，需要透過一次成功的{@dc 30}力量（運動）檢定才能拉開。{@spell knock||敲擊術}或類似魔法也能開啟它。

data/5/entries/9/entries/5/entries/3/ent.english: A character who makes a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom (Perception) check spots Vevette in the darkened theater. When this happens, Vevette springs from her chair and flees out the nearest door, planning to lead the characters on another merry chase. Remallia and her fellow Harpers watch with interest but don't get involved unless their lives or the lives of innocents are imperiled.
data/5/entries/9/entries/5/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 一個成功透過 {@dc 14} 感知（感知）檢定的角色會在昏暗的劇院中發現維維特。當這種情況發生時，維維特會從她的椅子上跳起，逃向最近的門，計劃帶領角色們進行另一場歡快的追逐。雷瑪利亞和她的哈珀同伴們饒有興趣地觀看著，但除非他們的生命或無辜者的生命受到威脅，否則不會介入。

data/5/entries/10/entries/4/entries/3/en.english: The entrance to the vault is hidden behind a secret door in the north wall of {@area O5|1b2}. The secret door was crafted by skilled dwarf engineers and requires a successful {@dc 20} Wisdom (Perception) check to locate. Esvele has already disarmed a magic trap on the door, rendering it safe to open. Beyond it lies a dusty staircase that descends 90 feet to a 20-foot-wide corridor. The hall extends another 90 feet to the vault doors. To one side of the vault doors, a natural fissure in the wall once served as a grick's lair, but Esvele killed the grick and left its corpse on the floor.
data/5/entries/10/entries/4/entries/3/en.zh_tw: 金庫的入口隱藏在{@area O5|1b2}北牆的一扇密門後面。這扇密門由技藝精湛的矮人工程師打造，需要透過一次{@dc 20}的感知（感知）檢定才能發現。埃斯維爾已經解除了門上的魔法陷阱，使其可以安全地開啟。門後是一條佈滿灰塵的樓梯，向下延伸90尺，通往一條20尺寬的走廊。大廳再延伸90尺便是金庫的大門。在金庫大門的一側，牆上的一個天然裂縫曾作為一隻格利克的巢穴，但埃斯維爾已殺死了這隻格利克，並將其屍體留在了地上。

data/5/entries/10/entries/6/entries/2/en.english: The tower is encircled by wooden scaffolding covered with ice and snow. Despite its precarious appearance, the scaffolding is secure and safe to walk on, enabling creatures to scale the outside of the tower without having to make ability checks. The scaffolding rattles and creaks, however, and any creature that moves on it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity (Stealth) check or be heard by the tower's occupants.
data/5/entries/10/entries/6/entries/2/en.zh_tw: 塔樓被覆蓋著冰雪的木製腳手架所環繞。儘管看起來搖搖欲墜，但腳手架確實穩固安全，可以行走，使生物能夠無需進行能力檢定即可攀爬塔樓的外部。然而，腳手架會發出嘎吱聲和震動聲，任何在其上移動的生物必須成功透過一個 {@dc 16} 敏捷（隱匿）檢定，否則會被塔樓內的居民聽到。

data/5/entries/11/entries/3/entries/4/en.english: The magister has already heard the testimony of the arresting officers, as well as that of any eyewitnesses. The characters are given an hour to plead their case while he asks questions. A character who tries to deceive Zastro must make a Charisma (Deception) check contested by the magister's Wisdom (Insight) check. A character who loses this contest is found guilty of hampering justice, locked up for a tenday, and fined 200 gp, on top of any other punishments meted out for crimes committed against the city and its citizenry. Those who can't or won't pay the fine are sentenced to hard labor for a year in Amendsfarm, a City Guard-run labor camp among the farms of Undercliff.
data/5/entries/11/entries/3/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 地方法官已經聽取了逮捕官員的證詞，以及任何目擊者的證詞。角色們有一個小時的時間來為他們的情況辯護，而他會提出問題。試圖欺騙扎斯特羅的角色必須進行一次魅力（欺瞞）檢定，與地方法官的感知（洞悉）檢定相對抗。輸掉這場對抗的角色將被認定為妨礙司法公正，被監禁十天，並被罰款200金幣，除此之外，還會因為他們對城市及其市民犯下的罪行而受到其他懲罰。那些無法或不願支付罰款的人將被判處在贖罪農場（一個城防軍運營的勞改營，位於崖下區的農場中）進行一年的艱苦勞動。
data/5/entries/11/entries/3/entries/4/en.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch; skill terminology: Insight; skill terminology: Deception

data/5/entries/12/entries/5/entries/1/ro.english: Korgstrod Uxgulm, the {@creature duergar} leader (40 hit points), seated in a stone chair and attended by 3 {@creature kobold||kobolds} (see "Stone of Deception" below)
data/5/entries/12/entries/5/entries/1/ro.zh_tw: 科爾格斯特羅德·烏克斯古爾姆，{@creature duergar||灰矮人}首領（40生命值），坐在石椅上，由3個{@creature kobold||狗頭人}（見下文的"欺瞞之石"）侍候

data/5/entries/13/entries/4/entries/2/en.english: As characters try to break into the cult fanatics' apartment, three {@creature spined devil||spined devils} arrive. The devils fly to the tower, knock on the apartment window, and are let inside by Seffia, whereupon Arn gives one of them the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. When the characters enter, they see the devils fly off with the stone. The cult fanatics do everything in their power to enable the devils to escape.
data/5/entries/13/entries/4/entries/2/en.zh_tw: 當角色們試圖闖入邪教狂信者的公寓時，三個{@creature spined devil||棘魔}到達了。魔鬼們飛到塔樓，敲了敲公寓的窗戶，瑟菲亞讓他們進來，然後阿恩給了他們其中一人{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。當角色們進入時，他們看到魔鬼們帶著石頭飛走了。邪教狂信者盡他們所能地幫助魔鬼逃脫。

data/5/entries/13/entries/5/entries/5/en.english: A heavy stone trapdoor in the floor of area W4a can be found with a thorough search of the room and a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom (Perception) check. Pulling open the door reveals a stone staircase that descends 120 feet to a 20-foot-wide corridor, which extends for another 60 feet and ends before the doors to the Vault of Dragons. {@creature Kalain|wdh} and Vhaspar know nothing of the vault or the trapdoor that leads to it.
data/5/entries/13/entries/5/entries/5/en.zh_tw: 在區域 W4a 的地板上，一扇沉重的石質活板門可以透過徹底搜尋房間併成功透過 {@dc 12} 感知（感知）檢定找到。拉開這扇門會露出一條向下的石階樓梯，向下延伸 120 尺，通向一條 20 尺寬的走廊，這條走廊再延伸 60 尺，最後止於通往龍之金庫的門前。{@creature Kalain|wdh|卡萊恩} 和 瓦斯帕 對這座金庫或通往它的活板門一無所知。

data/5/entries/14/entries/6/entries/2/en.english: Any creature of the construct type works as this key, provided the creature hasn't been destroyed or rendered inoperable. If the characters have befriended {@creature Valetta|wdh}, the dragonborn priest of Gond (see chapter 3), she happily releases Nim the {@creature nimblewright|wdh} into their custody until they no longer have need of it. An object animated by the {@spell animate objects} spell also qualifies as this key.
data/5/entries/14/entries/6/entries/2/en.zh_tw: 任何構造物型別的生物都可以作為這把鑰匙，只要這個生物沒有被摧毀或變得無法操作。如果角色們與{@creature Valetta|wdh|瓦萊塔}，貢德的龍裔牧師（見第3章）建立了友誼，她會很高興地將尼姆——{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}釋放到他們的監護下，直到他們不再需要它。透過{@spell animate objects||活化物件}法術被活化的物體也符合這把鑰匙的資格。

data/5/entries/15/entries/2/entries/5/en.english: A character who searches the hall for secret doors and succeeds on a {@dc 17} Wisdom (Perception) check notices the outline of a secret door that leads to {@area V5|242}. The door opens automatically when a dwarf (or a creature transformed into a dwarf with an {@spell alter self} spell or similar magic) touches it; otherwise, a successful {@dc 17} Strength (Athletics) check is needed to push open the heavy door.
data/5/entries/15/entries/2/entries/5/en.zh_tw: 一個在廳內搜尋密門併成功透過 {@dc 17} 感知（感知）檢定的角色會注意到一扇通往 {@area V5|242} 的密門的輪廓。當一名矮人（或被 {@spell alter self||變身術} 或其他類似法術轉變為矮人的生物）觸碰到門時，門會自動開啟；否則，需要一個成功的 {@dc 17} 力量（運動）檢定來推開這扇厚重的門。

data/5/entries/15/entries/2/entries/10/e.english: The characters can try to convince {@creature Aurinax|WDH} that they have come on Neverember's behalf. Since he has never met them before or heard Neverember mention them by name, {@creature Aurinax|WDH} is doubtful of their story. Fooling the dragon requires each character within his line of sight to succeed on a Charisma (Deception) check contested by the dragon's Wisdom (Insight) check. If even one character loses the contest, {@creature Aurinax|WDH} senses that the group is lying to him. These checks are made with advantage if {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh} is with the party, since the dragon remembers meeting Renaer when he was but a child and can easily imagine a scenario in which Dagult Neverember might use his son as his vassal. (The dragon knows nothing of the animosity between Renaer and his father.)
data/5/entries/15/entries/2/entries/10/e.zh_tw: 角色們可以嘗試說服{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}，他們是代表無燼而來。由於他以前從未見過他們，也從未聽無燼提及過他們的名字，{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}對他們的故事持懷疑態度。欺騙這條龍需要在他視線範圍內的每個角色成功進行一次魅力（欺瞞）檢定，與龍的感知（洞悉）檢定相對抗。即使只有一個角色在對抗中失敗，{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}也會感覺到這個團隊在對他撒謊。如果{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}與隊伍在一起，這些檢定將獲得優勢，因為龍記得他小時候曾經見過瑞納爾，並且可以輕易想象達格魯特 無燼可能使用他的兒子作為他的臣民的情況。（龍對瑞納爾和他父親之間的敵意一無所知。）
data/5/entries/15/entries/2/entries/10/e.reason: skill terminology: Insight; skill terminology: Deception

data/5/entries/15/entries/2/entries/10/e.english: Any Charisma (Intimidation) check made to influence {@creature Aurinax|WDH} automatically fails. After the first such attempt, all future Charisma checks made by the party to influence {@creature Aurinax|WDH} have disadvantage.
data/5/entries/15/entries/2/entries/10/e.zh_tw: 任何試圖影響{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}的魅力（威嚇）檢定都會自動失敗。在第一次這樣的嘗試之後，該隊伍未來所有試圖影響{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}的魅力檢定都將處於劣勢。

data/5/entries/15/entries/3/entries/4/en.english: Open Lord {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) arrives with {@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) and six City Guard {@creature veteran||veterans} to help characters secure the gold. Laeral's arrival forces Jarlaxle to be on his best behavior. After assuring Laeral of his good intentions, Jarlaxle cuts his losses and withdraws peacefully. If she is able to speak with {@creature Aurinax|WDH}, Laeral convinces the dragon to relinquish the gold into her custody.
data/5/entries/15/entries/3/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 開放領主{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）帶著{@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH|加萊斯特·銀鬃}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）和六名城防軍{@creature veteran||老兵}到達，幫助角色們確保黃金的安全。萊拉的到來迫使賈拉索表現得最好。在向萊拉保證他的好意之後，賈拉索減少損失並和平撤退。如果她能夠與{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}交談，萊拉說服龍將黃金交給她的監管。
data/5/entries/15/entries/3/entries/4/en.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/5/entries/16/entries/2/entries/1.english: Emissaries of the Harpers, the Lords' Alliance, and the Order of the Gauntlet come to the characters, asking that the gold be returned to Waterdeep. If the characters refuse to give it up, they are stripped of any memberships they might hold in these factions and quickly find themselves in political hot water. The Lords of Waterdeep charge them with the crime of robbery against the citizens of the city. The characters face up to 1 month of hard labor plus damages equal to the value of the stolen currency plus 500 gp. If they try to flee the city, the City Guard apprehends and imprisons them. If they somehow evade the local authorities, the Harpers and agents of the Lords' Alliance pursue them tirelessly.
data/5/entries/16/entries/2/entries/1.zh_tw: 豎琴手聯盟的使者、領主聯盟和鐵手套教團來到角色們面前，要求將黃金歸還給深水城。如果角色們拒絕放棄，他們將被剝奪在這些派系中可能持有的任何成員資格，並很快發現自己陷入了政治困境。深水城的領主們指控他們犯有對城市公民的盜竊罪。角色們面臨高達一個月的苦役，外加相當於被盜貨幣價值加上500金幣的賠償。如果他們試圖逃離這座城市，城防軍會逮捕並監禁他們。如果他們設法逃避地方當局，豎琴手聯盟和領主聯盟的代理人將不懈地追捕他們。
data/5/entries/16/entries/2/entries/1.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/3/ent.english: The secret door can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. To open it, one must press a nearby wall carving shaped like an eye. When this is done, the secret door swings inward, revealing a curved hallway ({@area X8|27f}) beyond.
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 秘密門可以透過一個成功的{@dc 15}感知（感知）檢定找到。要開啟它，必須按下附近一個形似眼睛的牆雕。當這樣做時，秘密門向內擺動，露出後面一條彎曲的走廊（{@area X8|27f}）。

data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/7/ent.english: The secret door in the south wall can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. It pushes open to reveal {@area X33|2bf} beyond.
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/7/ent.zh_tw: 南牆上的暗門可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定發現。推開後可以看到外面的 {@area X33|2bf}。

data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/13/en.english: Getting through the maze takes time but isn't difficult, except that {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} has rigged a tripwire halfway through. A character in the lead who is searching for traps spots the tripwire with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom (Perception) check. Once spotted, it can easily be avoided or disarmed. If the trap is triggered, the walls of the maze come crashing down. Every creature in the collapsing maze is hit by debris and must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) bludgeoning damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one.
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/13/en.zh_tw: 穿過迷宮需要時間但並不困難，只是{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}在迷宮的中途設下了一道絆線。在隊伍前導的角色如果正在搜尋陷阱，可以透過成功的{@dc 12}感知（感知）檢定發現絆線。一旦發現，它就可以輕易避開或解除。如果陷阱被觸發，迷宮的牆壁會崩塌下來。每個在崩塌迷宮中的生物都會被碎片擊中，必須進行{@dc 12}敏捷豁免，失敗則受到10點（{@dice 3d6}）鈍擊傷害，成功則只受一半傷害。

data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/15/en.english: This magically lit hall is concealed behind secret doors. It circumvents the audience chamber ({@area X18|29a}) and gently slopes down toward the east. Finding either secret door requires a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check.
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/15/en.zh_tw: 這個被魔法照亮的大廳隱藏在暗門後面。它繞過了覲見室（{@area X18|29a}）並緩緩向東傾斜。找到任一暗門都需要成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定。

data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/18/en.english: The secret door can be spotted with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. A pedal hidden in the floor, when stepped on, causes the door to swing inward.
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/18/en.zh_tw: 成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定可以發現這扇秘門。地板上的一個隱藏踏板，被踩下時會導致門向內擺動。

data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/20/en.english: While in this room, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} uses its {@item ring of invisibility} to remain unseen and can use a bonus action to activate or deactivate a psychedelic display of magical lights, each one the size of a human eyeball. The lights fill a 10-foot cube in the middle of the room, and the beholder can throw its voice so that it seems to emanate from the same area. Any character who succeeds on a {@dc 13} Wisdom (Insight) check can tell that the display isn't the source of the voice.
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/20/en.zh_tw: 在這個房間內，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}使用它的{@item ring of invisibility||隱身戒指}保持隱形，並且可以使用一個附贈動作來啟用或關閉一場迷幻的魔法光效，每一個光點都有人類眼球大小。這些光點填充了房間中央的一個10尺立方體，眼魔可以投射它的聲音，使其似乎從同一區域傳出。任何成功透過{@dc 13}感知（洞悉）檢定的角色可以辨別出這個光效並非聲音的來源。

data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/20/en.english: A hidden trapdoor in the floor can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. It can be lifted with a successful {@dc 12} Strength (Athletics) check, revealing a wooden ladder that leads down to {@area X29|2b9}.
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/20/en.zh_tw: 成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定可以發現地板上的一個隱蔽活板門。成功透過一次 {@dc 12} 力量（運動）檢定可以將其掀開，露出一架通向 {@area X29|2b9} 的木梯。

data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/36/en.english: The secret door can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. It pulls open to reveal {@area X6|27a} beyond.
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/36/en.zh_tw: 透過成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定可以發現這個密門。拉開後可以看到後面的 {@area X6|27a}。

data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/38/en.english: The chair behind the desk has a secret compartment under its left armrest that can be found and opened with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. This tiny compartment contains a small black key that unlocks both of the desk drawers. A character can pick each lock with a successful {@dc 17} Dexterity check using thieves' tools.
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/38/en.zh_tw: 辦公桌後的椅子在左側扶手下方有一個秘密隔間，可以透過一個成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定找到並開啟。這個小小的隔間裡有一把黑色小鑰匙，可以開啟辦公桌的兩個抽屜。角色可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 17} 敏捷檢定使用盜賊工具來開鎖。

data/7/entries/1.english: Victoro and {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH} struck a deal with Asmodeus, Lord of the Nine Hells. Three years ago, they traded away the souls of their children to escape financial ruin. The soul of their eldest son, Osvaldo, was taken immediately. What was left behind was transformed into a chain devil, which the Cassalanters confined to their attic. Their two youngest children, Terenzio and Elzerina, are doomed to lose their souls when they turn nine years old a mere ten days after Founders' Day, a midsummer festival that celebrates Waterdeep's founding.
data/7/entries/1.zh_tw: 維克托羅和{@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH|阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特}與九層地獄之王阿斯蒙蒂斯達成了一筆交易。三年前，他們為了逃避財務破產，將自己的孩子們的靈魂交易了出去。他們的長子奧斯瓦爾多的靈魂立即被帶走。留下的部分被轉變成了一個鎖鏈魔鬼，卡薩蘭特家族將其囚禁在他們的閣樓裡。他們的兩個最小的孩子，特倫齊奧和埃爾澤麗娜，在創立者節後的僅僅十天，也就是慶祝深水城建立的仲夏節日時，他們九歲生日時註定要失去他們的靈魂。

data/7/entries/2.english: After the deal was struck, the Cassalanters enjoyed a miraculous comeback. Their banking and money-lending business thrived while their competition suffered. The disappearance of their eldest son (and heir apparent) earned them sympathy. Their philanthropic endeavors bought them legitimacy and new friends. They became the envy of Waterdavian nobility in short order. Seemingly blessed, the Cassalanters attracted new followers to their cult of devil worship, which was Asmodeus's plan all along.
data/7/entries/2.zh_tw: 交易達成後，卡薩蘭特家族奇蹟般地東山再起。他們的銀行和放貸業務蓬勃發展，而他們的競爭對手卻遭受了損失。他們長子（也是繼承人）的失蹤為他們贏得了同情。他們的慈善事業為他們贏得了合法性和新朋友。他們很快成為了水深貴族羨慕的物件。看似受到祝福的卡薩蘭特家族吸引了新信徒加入他們崇拜魔鬼的邪教，這正是阿斯蒙蒂斯一直以來的計劃。

data/7/entries/7/entries/2.english: Cassalanter Villa is an extravagant manse with dozens of lavish chambers for the masters of the house and their guests-but its splendor belies the terrible secret it holds. The temple of Siamorphe that once lay beneath the estate has been desecrated by Victoro and Ammalia's devil-worship. Now, this great chapel is dedicated to the Lord of the Nine Hells.
data/7/entries/7/entries/2.zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特別墅是一座奢華的豪宅，擁有數十個豪華的房間供房屋的主人和他們的客人使用——但它的輝煌掩蓋了它所持有的可怕秘密。曾經位於莊園下方的希亞莫菲神廟已經被維克託和阿瑪莉亞的魔鬼崇拜所褻瀆。現在，這座宏偉的禮拜堂奉獻給了九層地獄之主。

data/7/entries/7/entries/3/entries/1.english: The house is surrounded by a well-manicured lawn. A cobblestone path leads from the estate's exterior gate to both the front entrance ({@area C1|2ee}) and the entrance to the coach house (area CH1). The villa's grounds feature numerous deciduous trees and meticulously tended gardens.
data/7/entries/7/entries/3/entries/1.zh_tw: 房子周圍是一片精心修剪的草坪。一條鵝卵石小徑從莊園的外門通向正門入口({@area C1|2ee})和馬車房入口(區域CH1)。別墅的場地上有許多落葉樹和精心照料的花園。

data/7/entries/7/entries/3/entries/3/ent.english: If the City Watch gets involved, Lord and Lady Cassalanter become worried that someone has caught onto their plot. The number of guards patrolling the grounds doubles, and Victoro dispenses with all human guards inside the house. Whenever a guard is mentioned in an interior area, that guard is now a {@creature bearded devil} disguised as a human. A disguised devil looks like a muscular, bearded male human in house livery. A creature that observes one closely can, with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check, notice its "beard" writhing.
data/7/entries/7/entries/3/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 如果城市守衛介入，卡薩蘭特勳爵和夫人會擔心有人識破了他們的陰謀。巡邏庭院的守衛數量會翻倍，而維克托羅會將屋內所有人類守衛撤換。每當在室內區域提到守衛時，那名守衛現在是一個偽裝成人類的{@creature bearded devil||須魔}。偽裝的魔鬼看起來像是一個穿著家徽制服的肌肉發達的鬍鬚男子。如果一個生物近距離觀察它，並透過一次成功的{@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定，可以注意到它的"鬍鬚"在蠕動。

data/7/entries/7/entries/4/entries/1/ite.english: The Cassalanters keep no silver objects (with the exception of coins) in their house, since silver is harmful to devils.
data/7/entries/7/entries/4/entries/1/ite.zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族在他們的房子裡不存放任何銀器（硬幣除外），因為銀對魔鬼是有害的。

data/7/entries/7/entries/5/entries/7/ent.english: The Cassalanter family portrait hides a secret door. Tilting the painting causes the door to swing outward on hidden hinges, revealing the pantry ({@area C11|305}) beyond. A character can notice a slight gap beneath the secret door with a successful {@dc 18} Wisdom (Perception) check.
data/7/entries/7/entries/5/entries/7/ent.zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族的肖像畫隱藏著一扇秘密門。將畫作傾斜會使門在隱藏的鉸鏈上向外擺動，露出後面的儲藏室（{@area C11|305}）。角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 18} 感知（感知）檢定注意到秘密門下方的一條細微縫隙。

data/7/entries/7/entries/5/entries/15/en.english: The secret door to the library ({@area C3|2f2}) can be detected by a character who makes a successful {@dc 18} Wisdom (Perception) check. The character discovers that lifting a bottle of Baldur's Gate pinot noir from the rack unlocks the door and allows it to be pushed open.
data/7/entries/7/entries/5/entries/15/en.zh_tw: 通往圖書館的密門（{@area C3|2f2}）可以由成功透過 {@dc 18} 感知（感知）檢定的角色發現。角色會發現從架子上拿起一瓶博德之門黑皮諾紅酒可以解鎖門並允許它被推開。

data/7/entries/7/entries/5/entries/35/en.english: A faded holy symbol of Siamorphe, a silver chalice bearing a golden sun symbol, is painted on the south wall. If the sun symbol is pushed, the wall grinds open, revealing {@area C29|330} beyond. A character who searches the wall automatically detects the secret door and can, with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom (Perception) check, figure out how to open it.
data/7/entries/7/entries/5/entries/35/en.zh_tw: 南牆上繪有一個褪色的神聖符號，代表著西莫菲，一個銀色的聖盃上帶著金色的太陽符號。如果按下太陽符號，牆壁便會移動開啟，顯露出後面的{@area C29|330}區域。一個搜尋牆壁的角色會自動發現這扇秘密門，並且可以透過一次成功的{@dc 10}感知（感知）檢定來弄清楚如何開啟它。
data/7/entries/7/entries/5/entries/35/en.reason: Wisdom uses site attribute name 感知

data/7/entries/8/entries/1/entries/1/ite.english: Cultists who aren't members of the nobility wear cheap red robes, devil masks, and wooden amulets that bear the symbol of Asmodeus.
data/7/entries/8/entries/1/entries/1/ite.zh_tw: 不是貴族成員的邪教徒穿著廉價的紅色長袍，戴著魔鬼面具，佩戴著刻有阿斯蒙蒂斯標誌的木製護身符。

data/7/entries/8/entries/2/entries/9/ent.english: Behind one of the bas-reliefs is a secret door, which can be detected with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom (Perception) check. Pushing against the sculpture causes a secret door to swing open into {@area A6|343}.
data/7/entries/8/entries/2/entries/9/ent.zh_tw: 在其中一塊淺浮雕後面有一扇秘密門，成功透過 {@dc 13} 感知（感知）檢定即可發現。推動雕塑會導致秘密門向 {@area A6|343} 方向開啟。

data/7/entries/8/entries/2/entries/10/en.english: Each wardrobe contains five complete outfits of cult regalia sized for adult humans: red robes, devil masks, and wooden amulets shaped in the symbol of Asmodeus.
data/7/entries/8/entries/2/entries/10/en.zh_tw: 每個衣櫥裡都裝有五套成人尺寸的邪教儀式服裝：紅色長袍、魔鬼面具和刻有阿斯蒙蒂斯象徵的木製護身符。

data/7/entries/8/entries/2/entries/11/en.english: The secret door leading to {@area A6|343} can be found with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom (Perception) check. Pushing on that section of wall causes it to swing open.
data/7/entries/8/entries/2/entries/11/en.zh_tw: 透過一次成功的 {@dc 13} 感知（感知）檢定可以發現通往 {@area A6|343} 的密門。推動該部分牆壁會使其擺動開啟。

data/7/entries/9/entries/1/entries/1.english: Armed with the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} and the keys to unlock the Vault of Dragons, {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} enters the vault, uses a {@spell disguise self} spell to appear as Lord Dagult Neverember, and tricks {@creature Aurinax|WDH} the gold dragon into relinquishing the gold. A dozen House Cassalanter {@creature guard||guards} disguised as members of the City Guard stuff the gold into sacks while a dozen more haul the sacks to a pair of waiting carriages for safe transport back to Cassalanter Villa. Each sack holds 1,000 gp, and each carriage can hold fifty sacks (50,000 gp) at a time. Getting the gold from the Vault of Dragons to Cassalanter Villa takes ten round trips (five per carriage) and the better part of a day. Three {@condition invisible} {@creature imp||imps} accompany each carriage, which is driven by a {@creature bearded devil} wearing a hat and a high-collared cape to conceal its true nature. Upon arrival at Cassalanter Villa, each carriage is met by a dozen {@creature guard||guards} in House Cassalanter livery, who unload the sacks of gold and place them in {@area C29|330}.
data/7/entries/9/entries/1/entries/1.zh_tw: 這個事件只能在創始人節或更早的時間發生。持有{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}和解鎖龍之金庫的鑰匙，{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}進入金庫，使用一個{@spell disguise self||易容術}法術將自己偽裝成達格魯特·無燼爵，並欺騙{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}這條金龍放棄金子。一打卡薩蘭特家族的{@creature guard||警衛}偽裝成城防軍的成員，將金子塞進麻袋，而另外一打則將麻袋運送到兩輛等待的馬車上，安全地運回卡薩蘭特別墅。每個麻袋裝有1,000金幣，每輛馬車一次可以裝載五十個麻袋（50,000金幣）。從龍之金庫將金子運送到卡薩蘭特別墅需要十次往返（每輛馬車五次），並且需要大半天的時間。每輛馬車由三個{@condition invisible||隱形}的{@creature imp||小魔鬼}陪同，由戴著帽子和高領斗篷以掩蓋其真實身份的{@creature bearded devil||須魔}駕駛。到達卡薩蘭特別墅後，每輛馬車都由一打穿著卡薩蘭特家族制服的{@creature guard||警衛}迎接，他們解除安裝金子的麻袋並將它們放置在{@area C29|330}。
data/7/entries/9/entries/1/entries/1.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/7/entries/9/entries/3/entries/3.english: While Ammalia plays host, Victoro instructs his cultists to remove the sacks of gold from House Cassalanter's vault ({@area C29|330}) and hurl them into the sacrificial bowl ({@area A7|345}). They finish shortly before midnight. At the stroke of midnight, as the poison does its work, Ammalia keeps an eye on her wealthy guests and orders Tessina Khyret to notify Victoro that the deed is done. Standing before the statue of Asmodeus in the temple, Victoro summons a {@creature barbed devil} and informs it that payment has been made in full. The devil declares (in Infernal) that the payment is "satisfactory" and informs Victoro that the souls of Terenzio and Elzerina will not be taken to the Nine Hells. It then disappears whence it came, leaving the Cassalanters to bask in their triumph.
data/7/entries/9/entries/3/entries/3.zh_tw: 當阿瑪利亞擔任主人時，維克托羅指示他的邪教徒從卡薩蘭特家族的金庫({@area C29|330})中移走金袋，並將它們投入祭祀碗中({@area A7|345})。他們在午夜前不久完成。隨著午夜鐘聲的敲響，毒藥開始發揮作用，阿瑪利亞監視著她的富有賓客，並命令蒂西娜·凱瑞特通知維克托羅事情已經完成。站在神廟中阿斯蒙蒂斯的雕像前，維克托羅召喚了一個{@creature barbed devil||蝟魔}，並告知它已全額支付。魔鬼（用地獄語）宣佈支付是"令人滿意"的，並告知維克托羅特倫齊奧和埃爾澤裡娜的靈魂不會被帶到九層地獄。然後它消失在它來的地方，留下卡薩蘭特家族沉浸在他們的成功中。

data/8/entries/3/entries/4/entries/1/ent.english: If the characters capture one of the captains and succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma (Intimidation) check, they learn the following information by asking the right questions:
data/8/entries/3/entries/4/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 如果角色們捕獲了一名船長併成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 魅力（威嚇）檢定，他們透過提出正確的問題將瞭解到以下資訊：

data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/9/ent.english: A gilded wooden figurehead of a female elf with flowing hair sticks out from the ship's prow, reaching forth with both hands. Since the figurehead is unpainted, there's no way to tell that it depicts a drow, but a character who inspects the figurehead closely and succeeds on a {@dc 13} Wisdom (Perception) check notices a tiny embossed spider on its forehead.
data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/9/ent.zh_tw: 一個鍍金的女性精靈木製船首像從船頭伸出，雙手向前伸展，長髮飄逸。由於船首像未上色，無法辨別它描繪的是一個卓爾精靈，但仔細觀察船首像並透過{@dc 13}感知（感知）檢定的角色會注意到其額頭上有一個微小的浮雕蜘蛛。

data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/11/en.english: Each captain keeps a modest collection of mundane books. Each hides his spellbook in a secret space under the bottom shelf, which can be found with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom (Perception) check. The spellbook contains the following spells: {@spell cone of cold}, {@spell control water}, {@spell counterspell}, {@spell detect magic}, {@spell fireball}, {@spell fly}, {@spell greater invisibility}, {@spell ice storm}, {@spell mage armor}, {@spell magic missile}, {@spell misty step}, {@spell Rary's telepathic bond}, {@spell sending}, {@spell shield}, {@spell suggestion}, {@spell thunderwave}, {@spell water breathing}, and {@spell web}.
data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/11/en.zh_tw: 每位船長都收藏了一些普通的書籍。每位船長都將自己的法術書藏在底架下的一個秘密空間中，只有透過一次成功的 {@dc 14} 感知（感知）檢定才能找到。法術書中包含以下法術：{@spell cone of cold||寒冰錐}, {@spell control water||操控水體}, {@spell counterspell||法術反制}, {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}, {@spell fireball||火球術}, {@spell fly||飛行術}, {@spell greater invisibility||高等隱形術}, {@spell ice storm||冰風暴}, {@spell mage armor||法師護甲}, {@spell magic missile||魔法飛彈}, {@spell misty step||迷蹤步}, {@spell Rary's telepathic bond||拉瑞心靈聯結}, {@spell sending||短訊術}, {@spell shield||護盾術}, {@spell suggestion||暗示術}, {@spell thunderwave||雷鳴波}, {@spell water breathing||水下呼吸}, 和 {@spell web||蛛網術}。

data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/18/en.english: A float bearing a mechanical armored knight battling a mechanical pit fiend (when wound up, the knight cleaves with its sword while the devil flaps its wings)
data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/18/en.zh_tw: 一個裝飾有機械裝甲騎士與機械深獄煉魔戰鬥的彩車（當它被上發條時，騎士揮舞著劍劈砍，而魔鬼則拍打著翅膀）

data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/21/en.english: Each pen is effectively a cell equipped with a sliding door that can be double-latched from the outside. A wagon assembled in {@area J19|385} can be backed up to any pen. With the pen door open, a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Animal Handling) check then coaxes a caged creature into the back of a wagon. This check is made with advantage if food is given to the creature. If this check fails by 5 or more, the creature escapes, panics, and begins attacking indiscriminately as it tries to win its freedom. Any such ruckus alerts the animal handlers or other crew members if they are nearby.
data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/21/en.zh_tw: 每個圍欄實際上是一個配有滑動門的牢房，可以從外部雙重鎖定。在{@area J19|385}組裝的馬車可以倒車到任何圍欄。當圍欄門開啟時，一個成功的{@dc 15}感知（動物馴養）檢定可以誘使籠中的生物進入馬車的後部。如果給生物提供食物，這個檢定將具有優勢。如果檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多，生物將逃脫、恐慌，並開始無差別地攻擊，試圖贏得自由。任何這樣的騷亂都會提醒附近的動物馴養師或其他船員。
data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/21/en.reason: Wisdom uses site attribute name 感知

data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/29/en.english: This closet abuts Jarlaxle's cabin ({@area J30|399}) and contains tailored outfits and cloaks for every season and occasion, as well as towels. Against the back wall stands a wooden mannequin wearing an eye patch. A secret door along one wall can be detected with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check.
data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/29/en.zh_tw: 這個衣櫥與賈拉克斯的艙室（{@area J30|399}）相鄰，裡面存放著為每個季節和場合量身定製的服裝和斗篷，以及毛巾。靠後牆立著一個戴眼罩的木製人體模特。沿著一面牆的秘密門可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定發現。

data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/29/en.english: This closet abuts the guest cabin ({@area J29|396}) and contains a half-dozen gowns and two soft fur cloaks on hangers, ladies' hats on hooks, and fancy towels and shoes on shelves. A secret door along one wall can be detected with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check.
data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/29/en.zh_tw: 這個櫥櫃緊鄰客艙（{@area J29|396}），裡面掛著六件禮服和兩件柔軟的毛皮斗篷，鉤子上掛著幾頂女帽，架子上放著精美的毛巾和鞋子。如果能成功透過 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定，可以發現一面牆上的秘密門。

data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/30/en.english: A secret door leading to a walk-in closet ({@area J28|393}) can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check.
data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/30/en.zh_tw: 透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定，可以發現一扇通往步入式衣櫥的密門（{@area J28|393}）。

data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/32/en.english: The ropes make all parts of this area {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. As part of its movement, a creature can maneuver around the ropes with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, negating the ropes' effect for that creature until the end of its turn.
data/8/entries/3/entries/7/entries/32/en.zh_tw: 繩索使得該區域的所有部分變為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。作為其移動的一部分，生物可以透過成功的{@dc 15}敏捷（體操）檢定繞過繩索，從而在該生物回合結束前消除繩索對其的影響。

data/8/entries/4/entries/5/entries/5/ent.english: The chest has a secret compartment in the bottom that can be detected and opened with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom (Perception) check. If Jarlaxle has the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, he keeps it in the secret compartment, along with any magic items he might have claimed from the characters. The compartment is otherwise empty.
data/8/entries/4/entries/5/entries/5/ent.zh_tw: 箱子底部有一個秘密隔間，可以透過成功的 {@dc 13} 感知（感知）檢定檢測並開啟。如果賈拉索擁有 {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，他會將其儲存在秘密隔間中，連同他可能從角色那裡獲得的任何魔法物品。否則，隔間是空的。

data/8/entries/4/entries/5/entries/8/ent.english: Three rock gnome {@creature engineer|wdh|engineers} named Lorella Middenpump, Tervaround Waggletop, and Anverth Leffery are on duty here, along with two {@creature drow elite warrior||drow elite warriors} named Karabal L'enz and Marro Qaz'arrt. The drow guard the control room and keep the gnomes on task.
data/8/entries/4/entries/5/entries/8/ent.zh_tw: 三名岩石侏儒{@creature engineer|wdh|工程師}，名為洛雷拉·米登泵(洛蕾拉·米登龐普)、特瓦拉文·瓦格託普(特瓦朗德·瓦格爾托普)和安弗斯·萊弗里(安弗斯·萊弗里)，以及兩名{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}，名為卡拉巴爾·倫茲(卡拉巴爾·倫茲)和馬羅·卡扎特(馬羅·卡扎爾特)，在這裡值班。侏儒們負責控制室的運作，而侏儒則負責監督侏儒們的工作。

data/8/entries/4/entries/5/entries/9/ent.english: Each of these four compartments contains an off-duty rock gnome {@creature engineer|wdh} sleeping in a small hammock, beneath which are two steel footlockers. The four rock gnomes are named Cockaby Fapplestamp, Ellywick Fiddlefen, Gerbo Reese, and Zaffrab Horcusporcus.
data/8/entries/4/entries/5/entries/9/ent.zh_tw: 這四個艙室中每個都包含一個下班休息的岩石侏儒{@creature engineer|wdh|工程師}，他睡在一個小吊床上，吊床下面有兩個鋼製儲物箱。這四個岩石侏儒的名字叫科卡比·法普爾斯坦普，艾利維克·菲德爾芬，格爾博·里斯，以及扎夫拉布·霍克斯普魯斯。

data/8/entries/4/entries/5/entries/9/ent.english: Each footlocker belongs to a particular gnome engineer stationed aboard the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}. Both contain folded clothes sized for a gnome. One of them also holds a set of grease-stained overalls and a set of tinker's tools that belong to the gnome asleep in the bunk. There is a {@chance 25|25 percent chance} that a footlocker also contains a clockwork toy, a fire starter, or a music box (as described in the "{@race gnome (rock)||Rock Gnome}" section in chapter 2 of the {@book Player's Handbook|phb}).
data/8/entries/4/entries/5/entries/9/ent.zh_tw: 每個行李箱都屬於一個特定的侏儒工程師，他們駐紮在{@i 緋紅馬佩諾斯}上。它們都包含了適合侏儒尺寸的摺疊衣物。其中一個還裝有一套沾滿油汙的工作服和一套屬於睡在鋪位上的侏儒的修補工具。有一個{@chance 25|25%的機率}，一個行李箱還包含一個發條玩具、一個點火器或一個音樂盒（如在{@book 玩家手冊|phb}第二章的{@race gnome (rock)||岩石侏儒}部分中描述的）。

data/8/entries/5/entries/1/entries/2/ent.english: A secret compartment in the chest's lid can be found with a successful {@dc 11} Wisdom (Perception) check. It contains a stoppered wooden scroll tube that holds a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell revivify}.
data/8/entries/5/entries/1/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 成功透過一次 {@dc 11} 感知（感知）檢定可以發現箱蓋上的一個秘密隔間。裡面裝有一個帶塞的木製卷軸筒，裡面放有一張 {@item spell scroll||法術卷軸} 的 {@spell revivify||回生術}。

data/8/entries/5/entries/5/entries/0.english: The Sea Maidens Faire parade ends where it started-at the docks. As the attractions are being loaded back onto their ships, the Faire's {@creature polar bear} gets loose, fleeing into the Dock Ward before its handlers can corner it. News of the escaped bear spreads quickly, and sightings are frequent. If the characters impressed one of the drow ship captains, he contacts them by way of a {@spell sending} spell and asks for help. He wants the bear retrieved before the City Guard finds and kills it, offering a reward of either 250 gp or a {@item potion of water breathing}.
data/8/entries/5/entries/5/entries/0.zh_tw: 海之少女節遊行在它開始的地方——碼頭結束了。當景點被重新裝載到他們的船上時，遊行的{@creature polar bear||白熊}逃脫了，在它的馴獸員能夠圍住它之前逃進了碼頭區。逃跑的熊的訊息迅速傳播開來，目擊事件頻繁發生。如果角色們給其中一個暗精靈船長留下了深刻印象，他會透過一個{@spell sending||短訊術}法術聯絡他們並請求幫助。他希望在城防軍發現並殺死熊之前將其找回，提供250金幣或一瓶{@item potion of water breathing||水下呼吸藥水}作為獎勵。
data/8/entries/5/entries/5/entries/0.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/8/entries/5/entries/5/entries/1.english: The characters can track and corner the polar bear with a successful {@dc 16} Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Survival) check. Whether a check succeeds or fails, each attempt represents 1 hour of searching. If the characters find the bear within 4 hours, it can be lured back to the Sea Maidens Faire with food or a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. The captain then makes good on the promised reward. If the characters don't find the bear, members of the City Guard get to it first and kill it.
data/8/entries/5/entries/5/entries/1.zh_tw: 角色們可以透過成功的 {@dc 16} 智力（調查）或感知（求生）檢定來追蹤並圍堵北極熊。無論檢定成功或失敗，每次嘗試都代表1小時的搜尋時間。如果角色們在4小時內找到北極熊，可以使用食物或成功的 {@dc 14} 感知（動物馴養）檢定將其引誘回"海之女郎節"。隨後，船長會兌現承諾的獎勵。如果角色們沒有找到北極熊，城防軍的成員會先找到並殺死它。
data/8/entries/5/entries/5/entries/1.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch; skill terminology: Survival

data/9/entries/2/entries/3/entries/2/ent.english: Once {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s whereabouts are established, the City Guard cordons off and surrounds Kolat Towers. The Blackstaff and the Watchful Order assist as needed. If the characters deactivated the force field, the siege is brief and {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s forces are routed. If the force field remains in place, the Watchful Order can deactivate it.
data/9/entries/2/entries/3/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 一旦確定了{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的行蹤，城防軍就會封鎖並包圍科拉特塔樓。黑杖和警戒秩序會根據需要提供協助。如果角色們停用了力場，圍攻將是短暫的，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的勢力將被擊潰。如果力場仍然存在，警戒秩序可以將其停用。
data/9/entries/2/entries/3/entries/2/ent.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/9/entries/3/entries/4/entries/1/ite.english: Some of the staircases in Kolat Towers are invisible. They are revealed by a {@spell see invisibility} spell or similar magic. A creature traversing stairs it can't see can move on the steps at half speed without any problem. A creature that moves any faster than half speed must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or slip, tumble down the stairs, and fall {@condition prone} at the bottom of them.
data/9/entries/3/entries/4/entries/1/ite.zh_tw: 科拉特塔中的一些樓梯是隱形的。它們可以透過{@spell see invisibility||識破隱形}法術或類似的魔法顯現出來。一個看不見樓梯的生物可以在梯級上以半速移動而沒有任何問題。一個移動速度快於半速的生物必須成功進行一次{@dc 10}敏捷（體操）檢定，否則會滑倒，從樓梯上滾下來，並在底部{@condition prone||伏地}。

data/9/entries/3/entries/5/entries/18/en.english: Any character who inspects the hall for traps and succeeds on a {@dc 17} Wisdom (Perception) check notices 1-inch-diameter holes drilled into the walls at ankle height, set at regular intervals along the length of the passage.
data/9/entries/3/entries/5/entries/18/en.zh_tw: 任何檢查大廳陷阱併成功透過 {@dc 17} 感知（感知）檢定的角色，會注意到牆壁踝部高度有直徑1吋的孔洞，這些孔洞沿通道長度方向以等距間隔排列。

data/9/entries/3/entries/5/entries/18/en.english: A character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check notices the secret door that leads to {@area K19|406}. This door opens normally only from inside {@area K19|406}, and only a {@spell knock} spell or similar magic can force it open from this side.
data/9/entries/3/entries/5/entries/18/en.zh_tw: 一個角色如果成功透過了 {@dc 15} 的感知（感知）檢定，會注意到通往 {@area K19|406} 的密門。這扇門通常只能從 {@area K19|406} 內部正常開啟，只有 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 法術或類似的魔法才能從這一側強行開啟它。

data/9/entries/3/entries/5/entries/19/en.english: A character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check notices the secret door that leads to {@area K19|406}.
data/9/entries/3/entries/5/entries/19/en.zh_tw: 一個成功透過 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定的人物會注意到通往 {@area K19|406} 的密門。

data/9/entries/3/entries/5/entries/20/en.english: Among the volumes on one shelf is a false book titled {@i The Man from Damara}—a wooden block painted to resemble a book, which is wired to a secret compartment in the base of the shelf. A character can detect the shelf and discern how to open it with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. Tugging on the book causes the compartment to pop open, revealing Duhlark's {@item wand of binding} hidden inside.
data/9/entries/3/entries/5/entries/20/en.zh_tw: 在一排書架上有一本假書，名為{@i 來自達馬拉的男人}——一個塗成書本形狀的木塊，與書架底部的秘密隔間相連。角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 15}感知（感知）檢定發現該書架並辨別如何開啟它。拉動這本書會使隔間彈開，露出藏在其中的杜爾拉克的{@item wand of binding||定身魔杖}。

data/9/entries/4/entries/5/entries/6/ent.english: Two barrels labeled "WATER" and two labeled "ALE" are crammed into a corner.
data/9/entries/4/entries/5/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 兩個標有"水"的桶和兩個標有「麥酒」的桶被塞在角落裡。

data/9/entries/4/entries/5/entries/7/ent.english: If he survived earlier encounters with the characters, {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) stands at the table, dourly scrubbing lab equipment. He is being punished for allowing the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} to slip through his fingers (during the events of chapter 3). Nevertheless, he remains loyal to {@creature Manshoon|WDH}. If he is confronted, Urstul feigns anger toward the wizard and offers to help the characters defeat him, but this ruse can be seen through by someone who makes a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom (Insight) check. Given the chance, Urstul leads the characters to {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, then attacks them to prove his unwavering loyalty in front of his master.
data/9/entries/4/entries/5/entries/7/ent.zh_tw: 如果他在之前的遭遇中倖存下來，{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）會站在桌旁，陰沉地擦洗實驗室裝置。他因為讓{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}從手中溜走（在第3章的事件中）而受到懲罰。儘管如此，他仍然忠於{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}。如果他被質問，厄斯圖爾會假裝對法師發怒，並主動提出幫助角色們擊敗他，但這種詭計可以被成功透過{@dc 14}感知（洞悉）檢定的人識破。如果有機會，厄斯圖爾會將角色們帶到{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}面前，然後攻擊他們，以在主上面前證明他的堅定忠誠。

data/10/entries/2/entries/1.english: You will have traveled through lands claimed and controlled by the Lords of Waterdeep long before you see its walls. If you've come from the south by the Trade Way, you'll have met the City Guard at their post at Zundbridge. From the north by way of the Long Road, you'll have passed under their watchful eyes at the town of Rassalantar. And whether by land or sea, you'll likely also have been spotted by the Griffon Cavalry—even if you have not spotted them.
data/10/entries/2/entries/1.zh_tw: 在你看到深水城的城牆之前，你已經穿越了水深城領主們聲稱並控制的土地。如果你從南方沿著貿易之路來，你會在宗德橋的哨所遇到城防軍。如果你從北方沿著長路來，你會在拉薩蘭塔爾鎮經過他們警覺的目光。無論你是走陸路還是海路，你很可能也已經被獅鷲騎兵發現——即使你沒有發現他們。
data/10/entries/2/entries/1.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/10/entries/2/entries/2.english: Worry not. Waterdeep is a welcoming city, and you have nothing to fear from these guardians unless you lead a rampaging army of orcs, a horde of gnolls, or similar. They don't even require a toll be paid. (Beware any City Guard who demands a toll, and report the incident to a magister of Waterdeep at your earliest convenience.)
data/10/entries/2/entries/2.zh_tw: 不必擔心。深水城是一個熱情好客的城市，除非你領導著一支暴走的獸人軍隊，一群鬣狗人群落，或類似的情況，否則你無需擔心這些守護者。他們甚至不需要支付通行費。（如果遇到要求通行費的城防軍，請小心，並在方便的時候儘快向深水城的一位法官報告此事。）
data/10/entries/2/entries/2.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/10/entries/2/entries/3.english: If you travel in a large caravan or on a ship, you will be required to register with a magister at the gate at which you arrived or with the harbor magister. Magisters can easily be recognized by the black robes they wear (and, in fact, are commonly called "black robes" as a result) and the City Guard force that always accompanies them. Be aware that magisters can pass a sentence without a trial. It behooves you to treat them with proper respect.
data/10/entries/2/entries/3.zh_tw: 如果你乘坐大型商隊或乘船旅行，你需要在到達的城門處向法官登記，或向港口法官登記。法官們很容易透過他們穿的黑色長袍辨認（事實上，他們通常被稱為"黑袍"，因此得名），以及總是伴隨他們的城防軍力量。請注意，法官可以在沒有審判的情況下作出判決。你應該以適當的尊重對待他們。
data/10/entries/2/entries/3.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/10/entries/4/entries/7/entries/0.english: As established in the first year of the reign of the previous Open Lord, Dagult Neverember, Waterdeep collects a monthly tax from all who live within its official wards. The tax is 1 shard per person above the age of ten years, and is collected door-to-door by patrols of the City Guard on the last day of each month.
data/10/entries/4/entries/7/entries/0.zh_tw: 正如前一位開放領主達格魯特·內弗梅伯統治的第一年所確定的，深水城向所有居住在其官方區域內的人每月徵收一次稅。稅款是每人一枚碎片幣，年齡超過十歲的人需要繳納，由城防軍的巡邏隊在每個月的最後一天挨家挨戶收取。
data/10/entries/4/entries/7/entries/0.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/10/entries/5/entries/6/entries/3.english: Many other buildings in the ward are given over to city business, including several courts for magisters and the barracks of the City Guard. So many of the ward's structures are offices and meeting halls for business owners, solicitors, publishers, and the like that the Castle Ward has the smallest resident population of all the wards.
data/10/entries/5/entries/6/entries/3.zh_tw: 該區域內的許多其他建築都用於城市業務，包括幾個地方法官的法院和城防軍隊的兵營。該區的許多建築是企業主、律師、出版商等的辦公室和會議廳，以至於城堡區的居民人口是所有區中最少的。
data/10/entries/5/entries/6/entries/3.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/10/entries/5/entries/7/entries/4.english: The Trades Ward uses green and purple as its colors, and its mascot is the mimic. This tradition supposedly arose because when mascots were first chosen, the Trades Ward took a chest of gold as its own-and was roundly mocked by citizens of other wards for not picking a creature. Now, every four years, the ward reveals a new object for its mascot, declaring it to be the mimic. The nature of the object is subject to much speculation and rumor until its unveiling. For months afterward, the object becomes the source of practical jokes in Waterdeep. Rock gnomes and wizards cause illusory mouths to lunge from real versions of the object, artisans craft beautiful fakes out of cake or paper that are easily crushed when assumed to be real, and so on. As of the writing of this enchiridion, the current mimic is a tankard.
data/10/entries/5/entries/7/entries/4.zh_tw: 商人區使用綠色和紫色作為其顏色，其吉祥物是擬身怪。這個傳統據說起源於當吉祥物首次被選擇時，商人區選擇了一個裝滿金幣的箱子作為自己的代表——並因此被其他區的市民嘲笑，因為他們沒有選擇一個生物。現在，每四年，該區會揭示一個新的物品作為其吉祥物，宣稱它是擬身怪。這個物品的本質在揭曉之前會引發許多猜測和謠言。之後的幾個月裡，這個物品成為深水城惡作劇的來源。侏儒侏儒和法師會讓真實的物品版本上出現幻覺的嘴巴猛撲出來，工匠們會用蛋糕或紙張製作出美麗的贗品，這些贗品在被誤認為是真品時很容易被壓碎，等等。截至這本手冊編寫時，當前的擬身怪是一隻酒杯。

data/10/entries/5/entries/11/entries/1/e.english: The Guild of Butchers operates several slaughterhouses, smokehouses, and leather-making facilities in the area-noisome operations that have been pushed out of the city proper. A word to the wise: being friendly with a burly fellow who is good with a knife is one of your best defenses in the Field Ward. The other place you might solicit aid is Endshift Tavern, a popular stop for off-duty members of the City Guard, situated on the corner of Endshift Street and the Breezeway. Though the guards might not be inclined to assist you, your status as a visitor to Waterdeep technically obliges them to help you reach the city proper in safety.
data/10/entries/5/entries/11/entries/1/e.zh_tw: 屠夫行會在該區域經營著幾家屠宰場、燻肉房和皮革製造設施——這些令人不快的操作已經被趕出了城市中心。給聰明人的忠告：與一個擅長使用刀子的健壯傢伙友好相處，是您在田野區最好的防禦之一。另一個可能尋求幫助的地方是收工酒館，這是城防軍下班成員的熱門聚集地，位於收工街和微風路的拐角處。儘管守衛可能不太願意提供幫助，但作為訪問深水城的遊客，從技術上講，他們有義務幫助您安全到達城市中心。
