data/10/entries/5/entries/11/entries/1/e.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/10/entries/5/entries/11/entries/3/e.english: Two noble families have estates in Undercliff. The Amcathra estate is used for the housing and final training of horses bred in the town of Amphail, many of which are sold to the City Guard. The Hothemer noble house has an estate where its members conduct business in overland trade-beyond the reach of Waterdeep's auditors.
data/10/entries/5/entries/11/entries/3/e.zh_tw: 兩個貴族家族在地底崖擁有莊園。安卡斯拉家族的莊園用於安置和最終訓練在安菲爾鎮飼養的馬匹，其中許多馬匹被出售給城防軍。霍瑟默貴族家族擁有一個莊園，其成員在那裡進行陸路貿易業務——遠離深水城審計員的觸及。
data/10/entries/5/entries/11/entries/3/e.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/10/entries/6/entries/2/entries/0.english: Waterdeep doesn't have the fabled flying ships of Halruaa, but it does deploy an aerial defense force. Brave warriors of the City Guard light out from the Peaktop Aerie atop Mount Waterdeep, riding fearsome griffons that have been bred and trained for that purpose. Each of the riders is equipped with a ring of feather falling—not merely to prevent death from mishap, but to allow them to perform stunning feats of aerial acrobatics.
data/10/entries/6/entries/2/entries/0.zh_tw: 深水城沒有傳說中的哈魯阿飛行船，但它確實部署了一支空中防禦力量。勇敢的城防軍戰士從深水城山頂的頂峰巢穴出發，騎著為這個目的而培育和訓練的可怕獅鷲。每位騎士都配備了一枚羽落戒指——不僅為了防止意外死亡，還允許他們表演令人驚歎的空中特技。

data/10/entries/6/entries/5/entries/5/en.english: The last two days of Fleetswake are the occasion of the Fair Seas Festival. During this time, there is much feasting on seafood, the harbor is strewn with flower petals, and City Guards go from tavern to tavern collecting offerings for Umberlee. Collection boxes also appear at large festival gatherings. Upon sunset of the final day, the collected coin is placed in chests and dumped into the deepest part of the harbor.
data/10/entries/6/entries/5/entries/5/en.zh_tw: 艦隊覺醒節的最後兩天是公海節慶祝活動的時間。在這段時間裡，人們大量享用海鮮，海港裡撒滿了花瓣，城防軍會從一家酒館到另一家酒館為烏姆貝爾萊收集供品。在大型節日集會上也會出現收集箱。在節日最後一天的日落時分，收集到的錢幣被放入箱子中，然後傾倒在海港最深處。
data/10/entries/6/entries/5/entries/5/en.reason: City Guard distinguished from City Watch

data/10/entries/6/entries/5/entries/13/e.english: Originally a celebration held only in Waterdeep, this holiday has since spread up and down the Sword Coast. It has received a recent boost in popularity from the custom started in Baldur's Gate of lighting celebratory smokepowder fireworks-all purchased from Felogyr's Fireworks of that city, and utilized only by the City Guard, of course. This nightlong festival honors the Lady of Joy with dances and balls throughout the city. Pink beverages, ranging from healthy juices to deadly strong intoxicants, are imbibed. The boom and crackle of smokepowder explosions go off all night long, so you might as well stay up with the locals and enjoy the show.
data/10/entries/6/entries/5/entries/13/e.zh_tw: 最初只在深水城舉行的慶祝活動，這個節日自那以後已經沿著劍海岸上下傳播。它最近因為博德之門開始的燃放慶祝煙火的習俗而人氣大增——所有煙火都購買自該城市的費洛吉爾煙火店，並且當然只有城防軍隊使用。這個通宵的節日以舞蹈和舞會的形式在整個城市慶祝歡樂女士。從健康的果汁到致命的烈性酒精飲料，粉色飲品被盡情享用。煙粉爆炸的轟鳴和噼啪聲整夜不斷，所以你不妨和當地人一起熬夜，享受這場表演。

data/12/entries/1/entries/0.zh_tw: {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的管家，對牛頭人很感興趣。儘管表面上彬彬有禮，這位盾矮人和最壞的魔鬼一樣狡猾和腐敗，但同時也對他的巨眼怪主人忠心耿耿。

data/12/entries/2/entries/0.english: The vainglorious {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|wdh|lady of House Cassalanter} is schooled in the arcane arts. Like her husband Victoro, she worships Asmodeus. When they were young, Ammalia and Victoro signed a contract with the archdevil, trading the souls of their children for power, good health, and long life. The soul of Osvaldo, their eldest son, was taken immediately, and he was transformed into a chain devil. The souls of the younger twins, Terenzio and Elzerina, will be taken when they turn nine years old.
data/12/entries/2/entries/0.zh_tw: 虛榮的 {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|wdh|卡薩蘭特家族的女士} 是卡薩蘭特家族的女主人，她精通奧術。和她丈夫維克託一樣，她崇拜阿斯蒙蒂斯。年輕時，阿瑪莉亞和維克託與大魔鬼簽訂了一份契約，用他們孩子們的靈魂換取力量、健康和長壽。他們的長子奧斯瓦爾多的靈魂被立即取走，他被變成了一個鎖鏈魔鬼。而年幼的雙胞胎，特倫齊奧和埃爾澤麗娜的靈魂將在他們九歲時被取走。

data/12/entries/10/entries/4/entries/1.english: Skeemo can add "sellout" to his credentials, his services having been bought by House Gralhund and the Black Network operatives loyal to {@creature Manshoon|WDH}. The rock gnome uses {@item paper bird|wdh|paper birds} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}) to send messages both to his new friends and his old ones.
data/12/entries/10/entries/4/entries/1.zh_tw: 斯基摩可以將"叛徒"加到他的資歷中，他的服務已經被格拉爾洪德家族和忠於{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的黑網特工買通。這位岩石侏儒使用{@item paper bird|wdh|紙鳶}（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）向他的新舊朋友傳送訊息。

data/12/entries/10/entries/5/entries/1.english: Tashlyn has established a useful cover by serving as a bodyguard to Vorondar Levelstone, a dwarf magister stationed at the South Gate. She likes the dwarf and has earned his confidence, allowing her to reach the rank of captain in the City Guard. In that position, she watches over traffic that passes through the gate-and ensures that her associates in the Black Network can come and go freely.
data/12/entries/10/entries/5/entries/1.zh_tw: 塔什琳透過擔任位於南門的矮人法師沃隆達爾·平石的保鏢，建立了一個有用的掩護。她喜歡這位矮人，並贏得了他的信任，使她得以在城防軍隊中晉升為隊長。在這個職位上，她監視著透過大門的交通——並確保她在黑網的同夥可以自由進出。

data/12/entries/29/entries/0.english: Ammalia and {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} traded the soul of their eldest child for power. Stripped of his humanity, Osvaldo was chained up in Cassalanter Villa and slowly transformed into a devil (and an insane one at that). Now a creature of pure evil and hate, he has no hope of regaining what was taken from him.
data/12/entries/29/entries/0.zh_tw: 阿瑪利亞和{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}為了力量交換了他們長子的靈魂。奧瓦爾多被剝奪了人性，在卡薩蘭特別墅被鎖鏈束縛，並逐漸變成了一個魔鬼（而且是一個瘋狂的魔鬼）。現在，作為一個純粹的邪惡和仇恨的生物，他沒有希望恢復被奪走的東西。

data/9/entries/3/entries/5/entries/4/ent.english: The halfling, {@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh}, is one of {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s lieutenants. He loves to cook, and uses his mage hand cantrip to cut vegetables. He assumes the characters are intruders unless convinced otherwise. Any ability check to do so is made with disadvantage, since Manafret knows that {@creature Manshoon|WDH} would have informed him if guests were expected. If the mage suspects the characters are intruders, he surreptitiously pours a vial of assassin's blood ({@dc 10} Constitution save, on a failure 10 ({@dice 3d6}) poison damage and {@condition poisoned} for 24 hours, half damage on a success and not {@condition poisoned}) into the stew before asking them to taste it and give him an honest critique. He then cries out to the guards in {@area K2|3db} and attacks. Combat in this area draws the attention of the Zhents in areas K2 and K7, who investigate.
data/9/entries/3/entries/5/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 半身人{@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh}是{@creature Manshoon|WDH}的副手之一。他喜歡烹飪，並使用法師之手戲法切菜。除非角色們說服他，否則他會把他們當成入侵者。由於馬納弗雷特知道，若預期有客人來訪，{@creature Manshoon|WDH}一定會先通知他，因此說服他的任何屬性檢定都具有劣勢。若這位法師懷疑角色們是入侵者，他會偷偷將一瓶刺客之血倒進燉菜，再請他們品嚐並坦誠評論。這種毒藥需進行{@dc 10}體質豁免，失敗則受到10（{@dice 3d6}）點毒素傷害並陷入{@condition poisoned}狀態24小時；成功則傷害減半，且不會{@condition poisoned}。隨後，他會高聲呼叫{@area K2|3db}的守衛並發動攻擊。本區域的戰鬥會引起K2與K7區域的散塔林會成員注意，他們會前來查看。
data/9/entries/3/entries/5/entries/4/ent.reason: Restore missing average poison damage 10 and preserve saving throw outcomes.

data/5/entries/10/entries/6/entries/1/en.english: Amath and her followers assemble here for worship but sleep elsewhere. When the characters first arrive, all five have gathered in prayer on the upper floor of the tower ({@area O3|1ac}). Three black {@creature flying snake||flying snakes} nest in the rafters and join any battle here. During this ceremony, Amath and her acolytes hold candles and form a circle around a gagged and blindfolded broadsheet publisher named Shan Chien (N male Shou human {@creature commoner}). The imperious, middle-aged man is shackled to the floor, and Amath carries the key to the shackles. The shackles can be broken by a creature that uses an action to make a successful {@dc 20} Strength (Athletics) check. Picking the shackles' lock requires thieves' tools and a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check.
data/5/entries/10/entries/6/entries/1/en.zh_tw: 阿瑪斯與追隨者在此聚會禮拜，但在別處睡覺。角色們初次到達時，五人全都聚集在塔的上層（{@area O3|1ac}）祈禱。三條黑色的{@creature flying snake||飛蛇}在屋樑上築巢，會加入此處的任何戰鬥。儀式中，阿瑪斯和侍僧們手持蠟燭，圍著一名被堵住嘴、蒙上雙眼的報刊發行人單建（中立，男性壽族人類{@creature commoner}）站成一圈。這名盛氣凌人的中年男子被鐐銬鎖在地板上，鑰匙由阿瑪斯保管。生物可以使用一個動作，成功通過{@dc 20}力量（運動）檢定來扯斷鐐銬。開鎖需要盜賊工具，並成功通過{@dc 15}敏捷檢定。
data/5/entries/10/entries/6/entries/1/en.reason: Restore all five worshippers; preserve actions and check conditions.

data/10/entries/5/entries/4/entries/4.english: Two other temples in the ward are as impressive, but in different ways. The beauteous House of the Moon has the tallest tower of any temple in the city, rising some seventy-five feet above the street. At its top, priests of Selûne bask in the light of the moon in all seasons. The House of Inspired Hands, dedicated to Gond, presents an altogether less peaceful experience. Here, all the great innovative minds of the city invent and experiment, attempting to create everything from flying machines to stronger door hinges. But don't expect a museum of marvels such as can be found in Baldur's Gate. At this site, "worship is work," as anyone at the temple is liable to tell you.
data/10/entries/5/entries/4/entries/4.zh_tw: 本區另有兩座同樣令人印象深刻、卻各具特色的神殿。美麗的月之屋擁有全城神殿中最高的塔，塔頂高出街面約75尺。塞倫涅的祭司一年四季都在塔頂沐浴月光。獻給貢德的巧手之屋則遠不如前者寧靜。城中偉大的創新者在此發明、實驗，試圖打造從飛行機器到更堅固門鉸鏈的各種事物。不過，別期待這裡有博德之門那樣的奇妙博物館。在此處，正如神殿裡任何人都可能告訴你的：「工作即崇拜。」

data/3/entries/4/entries/7/entries/3/ent.english: Characters can find {@creature Maxeene|WDH}, a {@creature draft horse} with an Intelligence score of 10, with a successful {@dc 13} Intelligence (Investigation) check. {@creature Maxeene|WDH} speaks Common, and characters must try to convince her that they're Harpers by making a {@dc 13} Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the horse recalls giving a ride to a sun elf and his half-orc bodyguard two days ago; she picked them up at an intersection (she doesn't recall which one) and dropped them off at the Yawning Portal. They talked about hiring spies to root out Xanathar Guild hideouts in the city. {@creature Maxeene|WDH}'s descriptions of the passengers match the appearances of {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH} and {@creature Yagra Stonefist|wdh}. {@i Reward}: Each Harper character gains 1 renown.
data/3/entries/4/entries/7/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 角色們若成功通過{@dc 13}智力（調查）檢定，就能找到{@creature Maxeene|WDH}。牠是一匹智力值為10的{@creature draft horse}。{@creature Maxeene|WDH}會說通用語；角色們必須進行{@dc 13}魅力（說服）檢定，讓牠相信他們是豎琴手聯盟成員。若檢定成功，牠回憶起兩天前曾載過一名日精靈與他的半獸人保鏢：牠在一處十字路口接到他們，但不記得是哪一處，並在呵欠之門讓他們下車。他們談到僱用間諜，找出城內姍娜薩公會的藏身處。{@creature Maxeene|WDH}對乘客的描述符合{@creature Davil Starsong|WDH}與{@creature Yagra Stonefist|wdh}的外貌。{@i 獎勵}：每名豎琴手聯盟角色獲得1點聲望。
data/3/entries/4/entries/7/entries/3/ent.reason: Source target is Xanathar Guild hideouts, not Zhentarim hideouts.

data/5/entries/7/entries/7/entries/4/ent.english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of transmutation that emanates from one of the stone coffins on the underground level. This crypt contains the shattered bones of Uld Brandath, a Waterdavian magister who died in a freak accident decades ago. (A gargoyle broke off the corner of a government building and fell on Uld, crushing him.) Guarding his remains are six {@creature crawling claw||crawling claws} made from the hands of murderers who were sentenced to death by Uld. These undead hands spring out and attack when the lid is lifted or shoved aside.
data/5/entries/7/entries/7/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: {@spell detect magic}法術會顯示地下層一具石棺散發的變化系靈光。墓中放著烏爾德·布蘭達斯的碎骨；他是深水城的裁判官，數十年前死於一場離奇意外：政府建築角落的一尊石像鬼裝飾掉了下來，將他壓死。六隻{@creature crawling claw||蠕行之爪}守護著他的遺骸，它們由曾被烏爾德判處死刑的殺人犯之手製成。棺蓋一旦被掀起或推開，這些不死之手便會躍出攻擊。
data/5/entries/7/entries/7/entries/4/ent.reason: Magister is a judicial office; remove unsupported mage gloss.

data/3/entries/3/entries/6/entries/1.english: The shop is managed by a short dragonborn of gold dragon ancestry named {@creature Rishaal the Page-Turner|wdh|Rishaal} the Page-Turner, who lives on the third floor. Rishaal, a member of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors, is a {@creature mage}, with these changes:
data/3/entries/3/entries/6/entries/1.zh_tw: 這間書店由一名個子矮小、擁有金龍血統的龍裔{@creature Rishaal the Page-Turner|wdh}經營，他住在三樓。瑞莎爾是警戒法師與護衛教團的成員。他使用{@creature mage}的資料，並有以下調整：
data/3/entries/3/entries/6/entries/1.reason: Complete proprietor name and remove leftover English epithet.

data/10/entries/4/entries/4/entries/1/it.english: "What befalls?" means "Someone tell me what's going on here."
data/10/entries/4/entries/4/entries/1/it.zh_tw: 「何事？」意即「誰來告訴我這裡發生了什麼事。」
data/10/entries/4/entries/4/entries/1/it.reason: Translate the Watch’s spoken commands and their explanations.
Translate the Watch’s spoken commands and their explanations.

data/10/entries/4/entries/4/entries/1/it.zh_tw: 「卸下兵刃！」意即「放下你們的武器。」
data/10/entries/4/entries/4/entries/1/it.reason: Translate the Watch’s spoken commands and their explanations.

data/10/entries/4/entries/4/entries/1/it.english: "Talk truth!" means "Answer me" or "Tell the whole story."
data/10/entries/4/entries/4/entries/1/it.zh_tw: 「據實以告！」意即「回答我」或「把事情完整說出來。」
data/10/entries/4/entries/4/entries/1/it.reason: Translate the Watch’s spoken commands and their explanations.

data/3/entries/4/entries/7/entries/3/ent.english: "Lady {@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH} is hosting a party at House Ulbrinter, her villa on Delzorin Street, located between Vhezoar Street and Brondar's Way in the North Ward. We have reason to suspect that drow spies have infiltrated the guest list. Attend the party and root out the disguised drow. Dress sharply."
data/3/entries/4/entries/7/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 「{@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH}女士正在她的烏爾布林特別墅舉辦派對。別墅位於北區德爾佐林街，介於維佐爾街與布隆達爾路之間。我們有理由懷疑卓爾間諜已混入賓客之中。去參加派對，找出偽裝的卓爾。記得穿得體面些。」
data/3/entries/4/entries/7/entries/3/ent.reason: Translate honorific and preserve House Ulbrinter as the villa hosting the party.

data/2/entries/3/entries/1/entries/2.english: The human combatants are five members of the Xanathar Guild (CE human {@creature bandit||bandits}). The one with the eye-shaped tattoos on his bald pate is their leader, Krentz. Their foe, Yagra Strongfist, is a half-orc employed by the Zhentarim (see the Yawning Portal Friendly Faces handout in appendix C). Yagra fights for her pride.
data/2/entries/3/entries/1/entries/2.zh_tw: 參與鬥毆的人類是姍娜薩公會的五名成員（守序邪惡，人類{@creature bandit||匪徒}）。光頭上刺有眼睛圖案的克倫茲是他們的首領。他們的對手雅格拉·石拳是一名受僱於散塔林會的半獸人（見附錄C的「呵欠之門的友善面孔」）。雅格拉正在捍衛自己的榮譽。
data/2/entries/3/entries/1/entries/2.reason: Restore the brawlers’ allegiance to Xanathar Guild, distinct from Yagra’s Zhentarim employer.

data/8/entries/4/entries/5/entries/6/ent.english: If he has not been encountered and defeated elsewhere, a {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH} named {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is here, cleaning his pistol. His stateroom contains a net hammock and a steel footlocker.
data/8/entries/4/entries/5/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 如果角色们尚未在其他地方遇見並擊敗他，一名叫做{@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH}的{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH}（見{@adventure 附錄B|WDH|12}）就在此處擦拭手槍。他的艙室裡有一張網狀吊床和一個鋼製床腳箱。
data/8/entries/4/entries/5/entries/6/ent.reason: Keep the character name attached to the individual and gunslinger attached to the creature type.

data/4/entries/1.english: Residents of Trollskull Alley are shaken by a loud whoosh, rattling windows, and the screams of city folk. A {@spell fireball} spell has just detonated in the street, and the neighborhood is thrown into chaos. As members of the City Guard, the City Watch, and the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors rush to the scene, the characters are afforded a chance to assess the damage and investigate further. This incident sets into motion the main plot and puts the characters on a collision course with those who want to find and claim Lord Neverember's hidden cache of gold.
data/4/entries/1.zh_tw: 巨魔顱骨巷的居民被巨響、震動的窗戶與市民的尖叫聲驚醒。街上剛剛發生了{@spell fireball}法術的爆炸，整個街坊陷入混亂。城市守衛、城防軍以及警戒法師與護衛教團的成員趕赴現場時，角色們有機會查看損害並深入調查。這起事件啟動了主要情節，使角色們與企圖找出並奪取無燼領主所藏黃金的人發生衝突。
data/4/entries/1.reason: Distinguish Watch and Guard where both appear together.

data/1/entries/3/entries/4/entries/0.english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is a paranoid, megalomaniacal beholder crime lord whose goal is to wipe out anyone it perceives as a Zhentarim operative or sympathizer, retrieve the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, and secure the cache of dragons. Its base is a dungeon under Skullport, a subterranean settlement beneath Waterdeep. This lair is described in chapter 5.
data/1/entries/3/entries/4/entries/0.zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 是一個多疑、狂妄自大的眼魔犯罪領主，其目標是消滅所有它認為是散塔林會行動人員或同情者的人，奪回{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，並確保龍幣寶藏。它的基地是位於骷髏港下的地牢，骷髏港是深水城下面的一個地下定居點。這個巢穴在第5章中有描述。
data/1/entries/3/entries/4/entries/0.reason: dragons are gold coins in the hoard

data/1/entries/3/entries/6/entries/0.english: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} is a drow swashbuckler and the secret lord of Luskan, the City of Sails. Jarlaxle plans to use the cache of dragons to buy his way into the Lords' Alliance, a confederation of cities and towns that band together against common threats. Jarlaxle also wants the {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH} for leverage in his negotiations. In the magical guise of a human sea captain named Zardoz Zord, Jarlaxle runs a traveling carnival called the Sea Maidens Faire and lairs aboard a ship in Waterdeep's harbor that has a submarine (the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}) underneath it, as described in chapter 7.
data/1/entries/3/entries/6/entries/0.zh_tw: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞} 是一個黑暗精靈冒險家，也是帆之城路斯坎的秘密領主。賈拉索計劃使用龍幣寶藏來購買進入領主聯盟的方式，領主聯盟是一個城市和小鎮的聯盟，他們聯合起來對抗共同的威脅。賈拉索還想要{@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖}作為他在談判中的籌碼。以一個名叫扎多茲·佐德的人類船長的魔法偽裝下，賈拉索經營著一個名為海之少女嘉年華的旅行嘉年華，並在深水城港口的一艘船上設有巢穴，這艘船下面有一艘潛水艇（{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}），如第7章所述。
data/1/entries/3/entries/6/entries/0.reason: dragons are gold coins in the hoard

data/1/entries/3/entries/7/entries/0.english: A clone of the wizard {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, one of the founders of the Zhentarim, is hiding in Waterdeep. He wants to rule the city, by claiming the cache of dragons and by using that wealth to bribe the Masked Lords into making him the new Open Lord. He also wants to regain control of the Black Network. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} lurks in Kolat Towers, a pair of wizards' towers in the Trades Ward. This residence is described in chapter 8.
data/1/entries/3/entries/7/entries/0.zh_tw: 法師{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的克隆體，是散塔林會的創始人之一，正隱藏在深水城。他想要透過聲稱擁有龍幣寶藏，並利用這筆財富賄賂蒙面領主們，使他成為新的公開領主，從而統治這座城市。他還想要重新控制黑網。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}潛伏在克拉特雙塔，這是位於商業區的一對法師塔。這個住所在第8章中有描述。
data/1/entries/3/entries/7/entries/0.reason: dragons are gold coins in the hoard

data/1/entries/9/entries/6/entries/1/ent.english: This adventure includes side quests available only to characters who join the factions described in this adventure. You can use the optional renown rules in chapter 1 of the Dungeon Master's Guide to track a character's rank and ascent within a given faction. The Dungeon Master's Guide gives names for various ranks within the Harpers, the Emerald Enclave, the Lords' Alliance, the Order of the Gauntlet, and the Zhentarim. Rank names for members of Bregan D'aerthe, Force Grey, and the Xanathar Guild are given below, with the renown needed to attain each rank.
data/1/entries/9/entries/6/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 這次冒險包括只有加入本冒險中描述的派系的角色才能使用支線任務。您可以使用《地下城主指南》第一章中的可選聲望規則來追蹤角色在給定派系中的等級和提升。《地下城主指南》為豎琴手聯盟、翠綠閒庭、領主聯盟、鐵手套教團和散塔林會的各個等級提供了名稱。布雷甘·達耶、灰色力量和姍娜薩公會成員的等級名稱如下，以及達到每個等級所需的聲望值。

data/1/entries/11/entries/6/entries/5/it.english: One adventurer receives a supernatural charm (see "Supernatural Gifts" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}) bestowed by Jeryth Phaulkon (see "Emerald Enclave").
data/1/entries/11/entries/6/entries/5/it.zh_tw: 一位冒險者獲得了由傑瑞斯·波康（參見"翠綠閒庭"）賜予的超自然護咒（參見{@book 城主指南|dmg}第7章中的"超自然恩賜"）。
data/1/entries/11/entries/6/entries/5/it.reason: charm is a supernatural gift, not Charisma

data/1/entries/12/entries/5/entries/6/en.english: An intellect devourer in league with {@creature Xanathar|WDH} ate Meloon's brain several months ago. Now under the monster's control, Meloon actively discourages adventurers from exploring Undermountain and urges them to focus on conflicts in the city instead. He also hunts down and kills Zhentarim operatives for his secret beholder master. He has his eye on {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) but won't kill the elf in plain view of witnesses.
data/1/entries/12/entries/5/entries/6/en.zh_tw: 幾個月前，與{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}有勾結的噬腦怪吃掉了麥倫的大腦。現在在怪物的控制下，麥倫積極勸阻冒險者探索地脈迷城，並敦促他們專注於城市中的衝突。他還追捕並殺死散塔林會的特工，為他的秘密眼魔主人服務。他盯上了{@creature Davil Starsong|WDH|達維爾·星歌}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），但不會在目擊者眾目睽睽之下殺死這個精靈。

data/2/entries/5/entries/0.english: Shortly after the characters find Renaer, a captain of the City Watch named Hyustus Staget (LG male Illuskan human {@creature veteran}) leads a dozen {@creature veteran||veterans} to the warehouse. Having received a report of suspicious activity, they barge in and try to prevent anyone from leaving. Kenku that are still alive and present are taken into custody, and it doesn't take long for the City Watch to conclude that the dead men are members of the Zhentarim and the Xanathar Guild, since violent encounters between the two factions are becoming ever more frequent. While his constables search the warehouse, Captain Staget questions the characters.
data/2/entries/5/entries/0.zh_tw: 角色們找到瑞納爾不久後，一位名叫海斯特斯·斯泰格特（休斯圖斯·斯塔吉特，守序善良男性伊路斯坎人人類{@creature veteran||老兵}）的城市守衛長帶領一打{@creature veteran||老兵}來到倉庫。接到可疑活動的報告後，他們衝進來並試圖阻止任何人離開。仍然活著並且在現場的天狗被拘留，城市守衛很快得出結論，死者是散塔林會和姍娜薩公會的成員，因為兩個派系之間暴力衝突正變得越來越頻繁。在他的警官搜查倉庫的同時，斯泰格特隊長詢問角色們。

data/3/entries/4/entries/7/entries/3/ent.english: Uza (LG female human Mulan {@creature commoner}) describes the threat as a "monstrous orb of many eyes" that chased her cat, Fillipa, into the shop. The monster is, in fact, a {@creature gazer|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). If the characters met a gazer in chapter 1, they know what they're up against. Uza lends them the keys to the front and back doors of her shop. Characters find the interior in shambles and hear a cat meowing on the third floor. The sounds are coming from the gazer, which is hunting Fillipa. The cat has so far eluded the nasty little predator. {@i Reward}: Each Harper character gains 1 renown if the gazer is defeated. Uza also gives the party a used spellbook containing four {@filter 1st-level|spells|class=wizard|level=1} and three {@filter 2nd-level|spells|class=wizard|level=2} wizard spells.
data/3/entries/4/entries/7/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 烏扎（LG女性人類穆蘭人 {@creature commoner||平民}）描述威脅為一個"多眼的怪物球體"，它追趕她的貓菲莉帕進入書店。實際上，這個怪物是一隻{@creature gazer|VGM|凝視者眼魔}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。如果角色們在第一章遇到了凝視者眼魔，他們就會知道他們面臨的是什麼。烏扎借給他們書店前後門的鑰匙。角色們發現內部一片狼藉，並聽到三樓有貓在喵喵叫。聲音來自正在追捕菲莉帕的凝視者眼魔。到目前為止，這隻貓已經成功躲避了這個討厭的小捕食者。{@i 獎勵}：如果擊敗了凝視者眼魔，每個豎琴手聯盟角色獲得1點聲望。烏扎還送給隊伍一本用過的魔法書，其中包含四個{@filter 11級或以上|spells|class=wizard|level=1}和三個{@filter 2級|spells|class=wizard|level=2}的法師法術。

data/3/entries/4/entries/8/entries/1/ent.english: Jalester offers membership in the Lords' Alliance to those who qualify. Members are expected to complete whatever missions are assigned to them in a timely, professional manner. Refusing to accept or complete a mission can result in suspension or dismissal. An alliance member who is suspended receives no alliance missions until the suspension ends, while dismissal from the alliance means a loss of membership and the loss of all renown in the faction.
data/3/entries/4/entries/8/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 加萊斯特為符合條件的人提供加入領主聯盟的會員資格。成員們被期望以及時、專業的方式完成分配給他們的任何任務。拒絕接受或完成任務可能導致暫停或解僱。被暫停的聯盟成員在暫停期結束之前不會收到任何聯盟任務，而從聯盟中被解僱則意味著失去會員資格以及在派系中的所有聲望。

data/3/entries/4/entries/10/entries/4/en.english: {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) has placed four potions of poison in a small silk-lined coffer. The potions look, smell, and taste like potions of mind reading. Awaiting delivery near the God Catcher is Esvele Rosznar, the {@creature Black Viper|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). She wears a hooded purple cloak and is seated in the back of a hire-coach. She exchanges the coffer for a black velvet pouch, then orders her driver to depart. The coach delivers Esvele to her estate in the Sea Ward. {@i Reward}: Each Zhentarim character gains 1 renown. Esvele's pouch contains 15 pp, which the characters can keep.
data/3/entries/4/entries/10/entries/4/en.zh_tw: {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH|斯齊莫·奇瓶}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）在一個小的絲綢襯裡的箱子裡放了四瓶毒藥。這些藥水看起來、聞起來、嚐起來都像是讀心藥水。在捕神者附近等待交付的是艾絲薇爾·羅茲納爾，{@creature Black Viper|WDH|黑毒蛇}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。她穿著帶兜帽的紫色斗篷，坐在一輛租來的馬車裡。她用箱子交換了一個黑色天鵝絨袋子，然後命令她的司機出發。馬車將艾絲薇爾送到她在海區的莊園。{@i 獎勵}：每個散塔林會角色獲得1點聲望。艾絲薇爾的袋子裡有15枚鉑金幣，角色們可以保留。
data/3/entries/4/entries/10/entries/4/en.reason: Remove an invented Black Snake gang; Black Viper is Esvele’s alias.

data/3/entries/4/entries/10/entries/4/en.english: {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) manages to stay one step ahead of the characters. As they approach his shop, they see him ride off in a dray with five other passengers and a driver (all {@creature commoner||commoners}). If Skeemo realizes he's being followed, he casts fly and takes to the air. If the effect is dispelled or the characters maintain pursuit, he casts greater invisibility on himself and uses crowds to cover his escape. If the characters fail to nab him, he takes refuge in Kolat Towers (see chapter 8). {@i Reward}: Each Zhentarim character gains 2 renown if Skeemo is eliminated without implicating the Black Network. In addition, characters who snatch Skeemo's satchel find that it holds his spellbook (containing all the spells he has prepared), a {@item potion of mind reading}, and 150 gp in a silk coin purse.
data/3/entries/4/entries/10/entries/4/en.zh_tw: {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH|斯齊莫·奇瓶}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）設法比角色們領先一步。當他們接近他的商店時，他們看到他和其他五名乘客以及一名司機（都是{@creature commoner||平民}）一起乘坐貨車離開。如果斯齊莫意識到自己被跟蹤，他會施放飛行術並飛向空中。如果效果被解除或者角色們繼續追擊，他會對自己施放高等隱形術，並利用人群來掩護他的逃跑。如果角色們未能抓住他，他會在克拉特雙塔（見第8章）中尋求庇護。{@i 獎勵}：如果斯齊莫在不牽連黑網的情況下被消滅，每個散塔林會角色獲得2點聲望。此外，抓住斯齊莫的揹包的角色會發現揹包裡有他的法術書（包含他準備的所有法術）、一瓶{@item potion of mind reading||讀心藥水}，以及一個絲綢錢袋裡的150金幣。

data/4/entries/7/entries/3/entries/0.english: The dead are taken to a City Watch station in the North Ward and kept in a cellar morgue. Clerics from local temples are brought in to cast {@spell gentle repose} spells on the corpses, to preserve them while the investigation is ongoing. Any character who has a renown of 1 or higher in Force Grey (the Gray Hands), the Harpers, the Lords' Alliance, the Order of the Gauntlet, or the Zhentarim can petition their faction representative to hire a cleric to cast {@spell speak with dead} on one or more of the fatalities.
data/4/entries/7/entries/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 死者被送往北區的城市守衛站，並存放在地下室太平間。當地寺廟的牧師被請來對屍體施放{@spell gentle repose||遺體防腐}法術，以在調查進行時儲存它們。任何在灰色力量（灰手）、豎琴手聯盟、領主聯盟、鐵手套教團或散塔林會中擁有1點或更高聲望的角色都可以請求他們派系的代表僱傭一位牧師對一個或多個死者施放{@spell speak with dead||死者交談}法術。

data/5/entries/1.english: Gold makes people do strange things, and Lord Neverember's hidden cache of dragons is up for grabs. The {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} knows where the treasure vault is located and how to get inside, and much of this chapter focuses on the characters' hunt for the artifact. The challenges before them depend on the villain (or villains) that you selected to oppose them. Whatever the season, a villain's goals are simple: obtain the stone, find the Vault of Dragons, and claim the treasure within.
data/5/entries/1.zh_tw: 金錢使人做出奇怪的事情，而無燼領主隱藏的龍幣寶藏正待爭奪。{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}知道寶藏庫的位置以及如何進入，這一章的大部分內容集中在角色尋找這個神器的過程上。他們面臨的挑戰取決於你選擇的反派（或反派們）。無論季節如何，反派的目標都很簡單：獲得石頭，找到龍之寶庫，並奪取其中的寶藏。
data/5/entries/1.reason: dragons are gold coins in the hoard

data/5/entries/3/entries/9/entries/1/ent.english: If he is captured and questioned, Agorn reveals that he made one stop on his way to Mistshore. He dropped off a lady friend, a priest of Bane allied with the Zhentarim, and left the stone with her and her acolytes for safekeeping. The characters can find them in an old tower in the Castle Ward (encounter 7, "Old Tower"). Before they leave that place, the characters are confronted by {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s simulacrum, which arrives by way of teleportation circle to collect the stone. Once the simulacrum is defeated, the characters can use the stone to learn that the entrance to the Vault of Dragons is hidden below a mausoleum in the City of the Dead (encounter 4, "Mausoleum").
data/5/entries/3/entries/9/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 如果阿戈恩被捕並受到審問，他會透露在前往霧岸的路上他停了一次。他送下了一位女士朋友，一位與散塔林會結盟的班恩的女祭司，並把石頭留給了她和她的門徒保管。角色們可以在城堡區的一座舊塔中找到他們（遭遇7，'舊塔'）。在他們離開那個地方之前，角色們被{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的擬像所挑戰，它透過傳送法陣到達這裡來收集石頭。一旦擬像被擊敗，角色們可以使用石頭得知龍之寶庫的入口隱藏在亡者之城的一個陵墓下（遭遇4，'陵墓'）。
data/5/entries/3/entries/9/entries/1/ent.reason: simulacrum is a physical duplicate, not an illusion

data/5/entries/4/entries/5/entries/3/ent.english: Agents of the Lords' Alliance recently labeled Fenerus as a wanted brigand and notified the Lords of Waterdeep, who sent the City Watch to arrest him. Fenerus had the good sense to hide the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} elsewhere and hopes to use it as leverage to gain his freedom as well as forgiveness for past crimes.
data/5/entries/4/entries/5/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 最近，領主聯盟的特工將費內魯斯標記為通緝的強盜，並將此通知了深水城的領主們，他們派遣城市守衛去逮捕他。費內魯斯明智地將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}藏在別處，並希望利用它作為籌碼，以換取自由以及對過去罪行的寬恕。

data/5/entries/11/entries/4/entries/2/it.english: A character who has at least 4 renown in the Lords' Alliance can arrange a meeting with {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) at Piergeiron's Palace and convince her to give Fenerus what he wants in exchange for information on the stone's whereabouts. The safe return of Neverember's cache of dragons is more important to her than the fate of one brigand.
data/5/entries/11/entries/4/entries/2/it.zh_tw: 至少在領主聯盟中有4點聲望的角色可以安排在皮爾蓋隆的宮殿與{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）會面，並說服她給予費內魯斯他想要的東西，以換取關於石頭下落的資訊。對她來說，安全返回尼維爾伯的龍藏比一個強盜的命運更重要。

data/5/entries/15/entries/3/entries/1/it.english: If {@creature Manshoon|WDH} is the main villain, he sends his simulacrum (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) along with Agorn Fuoco (NE male Turami human {@creature bard|VGM}; see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), Vevette Blackwater (CE female Tethyrian human {@creature swashbuckler|VGM}; see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), and three Zhent {@creature thug||thugs}. If Agorn and Vevette were killed or otherwise disposed of earlier in this chapter or in chapter 8, replace each of them with one additional {@creature thug}.
data/5/entries/15/entries/3/entries/1/it.zh_tw: 如果{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}是主要反派，他將派出他的擬像（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）以及阿戈恩·弗奧科（NE男性圖拉米人人類{@creature bard|VGM|吟遊詩人}；見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）、薇薇特·黑水（CE女性泰瑟爾人人類{@creature swashbuckler|VGM|風流劍客}；見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）和三名散塔林會成員{@creature thug||暴徒}。如果在本章或第8章早些時候阿戈恩和薇薇特被殺或以其他方式處理，將他們中的每一個替換為一個額外的{@creature thug||暴徒}。

data/5/entries/15/entries/3/entries/4/en.english: The Doom Raiders (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) arrive to help secure the vault, less any members who have been arrested or killed. If {@creature Manshoon|WDH} is the main villain, {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH} betrays his fellow Doom Raiders and fights alongside {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s simulacrum. If they and the characters emerge victorious, the surviving Doom Raiders propose to split the take evenly with the characters. If the characters refuse this offer and the Doom Raiders outnumber them, the Zhents turn against them, putting characters who are Zhentarim members in a predicament.
data/5/entries/15/entries/3/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 末日劫掠者（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）到達幫助確保金庫的安全，不包括已經被逮捕或殺死的成員。如果{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}是主要反派，{@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH|斯齊莫·奇瓶}背叛了他的末日劫掠者同伴，與{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的擬像並肩作戰。如果他們和角色們取得勝利，倖存的末日劫掠者提議與角色們平均分配收益。如果角色們拒絕這個提議，並且末日劫掠者的人數超過他們，散塔林會成員會反對他們，這讓散塔林會的成員角色們陷入困境。

data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/30/en.english: Imprisoned in the westernmost cell along the north wall is Hyustus Staget, a captain of the City Watch whom the characters have met (see "The Watch Arrives"). He was kidnapped while off duty and is without his armor and weapons. If Hyustus has died for whatever reason, replace him with a female human Watch officer named Cressa Galavarco (LG female Tethyrian {@creature veteran} with no armor or weapons). Whoever is here has a date with an intellect devourer.
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/30/en.zh_tw: 被關押在北牆最西端牢房的是休斯圖斯·斯塔吉特，他是城市守衛的隊長，角色們已經見過他（見"警衛到達"）。他在休假時被綁架，沒有穿戴盔甲和武器。如果休斯圖斯因任何原因死亡，請用一位名叫克蕾莎·加拉瓦爾科的女性人類警衛官員（守序善良女性泰瑟爾人 {@creature veteran||老兵}，沒有盔甲或武器）來替換他。無論是誰在這裡，都註定要成為噬腦怪的物件。

data/9/entries/3/entries/5/entries/14/en.english: The gargoyle retains fragmented memories of the life of {@creature Lady Gondafrey|WDH}, a native Waterdavian who served in the City Watch. After identifying Duhlark Kolat as a suspect in several local disappearances, she darkened his doorstep in 1379 DR, the Year of the Lost Keep. Annoyed by this invasion of his privacy and not in his right mind, Duhlark captured {@creature Lady Gondafrey|WDH}, used a spell to meld her form with that of a gargoyle, and imprisoned her.
data/9/entries/3/entries/5/entries/14/en.zh_tw: 這個石像鬼保留了{@creature Lady Gondafrey|WDH|岡達弗蕾女士}生活的片段記憶，她是一個本地的深水城居民，曾在城市守衛服役。在1379 DR年，也就是失落要塞年，她將杜爾卡·克拉特認定為幾起當地失蹤案的嫌疑人，並因此出現在他的家門口。杜爾卡因這次侵犯他的隱私而惱怒，並且他當時並不清醒，於是他捕獲了{@creature Lady Gondafrey|WDH|岡達弗蕾女士}，使用了一個法術將她的身體與石像鬼融合，並把她囚禁起來。

data/12/entries/9/entries/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 大多數城市守衛成員是{@creature veteran||老兵}。一些級別最高的成員是{@creature knight||騎士}。所有城市守衛成員在值班時都戴頭盔並攜帶{@item club|phb|短棒}。

data/12/entries/10/entries/6/entries/1.english: The City Watch has received reports of a figure who haunts the rooftops of Waterdeep-a hulking shadow that glares from its perch, rains down death in the form of long black arrows, and slinks off without so much as a whisper. Where he comes from-if he even has a home-remains a mystery, as does the question of where he might show up next.
data/12/entries/10/entries/6/entries/1.zh_tw: 城市守衛收到了關於一個在深水城屋頂上游蕩的身影的報告——一個巨大的陰影從其棲息地怒視，以長黑箭的形式降下死亡，並在連一絲耳語都沒有的情況下悄悄離開。他來自哪裡——如果他甚至有家——仍是一個謎，就像他下次可能出現的地方一樣。

data/12/entries/33/entries/0.english: {@creature Saeth Cromley|wdh} is a retired {@creature sergeant|WDH} of the City Watch, a likable fellow with a sharp, sarcastic wit. He occasionally comes out of retirement at the request of {@creature Barnibus Blastwind|WDH}, and he assists the mage in investigating unusual crimes in the city. Cromley helps Barnibus relate to the common folk, and he is good at coaxing information out of them. Though Cromley was once a strict proponent of Watch regulations and dress codes, he has grown a bit lax in both matters now that he's officially retired.
data/12/entries/33/entries/0.zh_tw: {@creature Saeth Cromley|wdh|薩斯·克姆利}是城市守衛一位已退役的{@creature sergeant|WDH|軍士}，一個討人喜歡的傢伙，有著尖銳且諷刺的機智。他偶爾會應{@creature Barnibus Blastwind|WDH|巴尼布斯·陣風}的請求重新出山，協助這位法師調查城市中不尋常的犯罪。克姆利幫助巴尼布斯與普通民眾打交道，並且他擅長從他們那裡引出資訊。儘管克姆利曾經是警衛隊規章制度和著裝規範的嚴格支持者，但自從他正式退休後，在這兩方面都變得有些鬆懈了。

data/12/entries/36/entries/0.english: {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} works for {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, and he is the highest-ranking member of the Zhentarim squad stationed at House Gralhund. Urstul is a glorified thug with all the charm and breeding of a snake, but the Gralhunds tolerate him because he feeds them useful information culled from his spies throughout the city. Urstul takes his orders from {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s current simulacrum, which comes and goes from House Gralhund by way of a teleportation circle (connected to the circle in Kolat Towers).

data/10/entries/6/entries/5/entries/6/en.english: This festival has long gathered a number of older holidays under one name, stretching those celebrations into a holiday season that lasts a tenday. Among the rituals in homage to the goddess of wealth and trade are these: {@b Caravance (Tarsahk 1}). This gift-giving holiday commemorates the traditional arrival of the first caravans of the season into the city. Many parents hide gifts for their offspring in their homes, telling the children that they were left by Old Carvas—a mythical peddler who arrived with the first caravan to reach Waterdeep, his wagon loaded down with toys for children to enjoy. {@b Goldenight (Tarsahk 5}). This festival celebrates coin and {@item gold|PHB}, with many businesses staying open all night, offering midnight sales and other promotions. Some celebrants and customers decorate themselves with gold dust and wear coins as jewelry. {@b Guildsmeet (Tarsahk 7}). On this holiday, guild members gather in their halls for the announcement of new policies and a celebration of business concluded for the year. These gatherings culminate in a gala festival and dance sponsored by several guilds, which lasts from dusk till dawn and overruns the Market, the Cynosure, the Field of Triumph, and all areas in between. {@b Leiruin (Tarsahk 10}). In times long past, Waukeen caught Leira, the goddess of illusions and deception, attempting to cheat her in a deal, and buried her under a mountain of molten gold as punishment. A commemoration of that event, Leiruin is the day for guild members to pay their annual dues and for guildmasters to meet with the Lords of Waterdeep and renew their charters for another year.
data/10/entries/6/entries/5/entries/6/en.zh_tw: 這個節慶早已把數個古老節日統合在同一名稱下，延伸為持續十天的節期。其中，向財富與貿易女神致敬的儀式包括：{@b 商隊節（塔薩克1日）}。這個互贈禮物的節日，紀念本季首批商隊抵達城中的傳統。許多父母把禮物藏在家裡，告訴孩子們，禮物是老卡瓦斯留下的。這位傳說中的小販隨第一支抵達深水城的商隊前來，馬車上滿載供孩子玩樂的玩具。{@b 金夜節（塔薩克5日）}。這個節日歌頌錢幣與{@item gold|PHB}。許多商家徹夜營業，提供午夜特賣與其他優惠；有些慶祝者和顧客以金粉裝飾自己，並把錢幣當成珠寶佩戴。{@b 行會聚會日（塔薩克7日）}。行會成員在各自的會館集合，宣告新政策，慶祝當年完成的生意。聚會最終迎來由數個行會贊助的盛大慶典與舞會，從黃昏持續到黎明，遍及市場、神會之殿、凱旋競技場，以及其間所有區域。{@b 雷烏林節（塔薩克10日）}。久遠以前，渥金撞見幻象與欺瞞女神蕾拉企圖在交易中欺騙她，便將蕾拉埋在熔金堆成的山下作為懲罰。雷烏林節紀念這件事；當天行會成員繳納年費，行會首領也與深水城領主會面，續訂下一年的特許狀。

data/2/entries/3/entries/3/entries/5/ent.english: Unbeknownst to Volo, not long after he departed, a drunken Floon met another acquaintance, Lord {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh}, at the tavern. The two left together, with Renaer offering to walk Floon home. Five Zhentarim thugs working for {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) jumped both Floon and Renaer. They took them to a warehouse in the Dock Ward, so they could question Renaer-the son of Lord Dagult Neverember-about the whereabouts of the Stone of Golorr and his father's hidden cache of dragons. Before the interrogation could begin, members of the Xanathar Guild ambushed and killed the Zhent guards in the warehouse. The new arrivals mistook Floon for Renaer, knocked Floon {@condition unconscious}, and dragged him away while Renaer hid and escaped their notice.
data/2/entries/3/entries/3/entries/5/ent.zh_tw: 瓦羅並不知道，他離開後不久，醉醺醺的福盧恩在酒館遇到了另一位熟人——{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}領主。兩人一同離開，瑞納爾主動提出送福盧恩回家。五名替{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}（見{@adventure 附錄B|WDH|12}）效力的散塔林會暴徒伏擊了他們，將兩人帶到碼頭區的一座倉庫，打算審問達格魯特·無燼領主之子瑞納爾，查出格洛爾之石的下落，以及他父親藏匿龍幣寶藏的地點。審訊尚未開始，姍娜薩公會的成員便伏擊並殺死了倉庫中的散塔林會守衛。後來的襲擊者將福盧恩誤認為瑞納爾，把他打至{@condition unconscious||昏迷}後拖走；瑞納爾則躲了起來，沒有被他們發現。
data/2/entries/3/entries/3/entries/5/ent.reason: restore kidnappers, ambushers, victims, mistaken identity, and dragons as gold coins

data/2/entries/6/entries/0.english: At this point, the characters likely know that Floon was kidnapped by Xanathar Guild members who mistook him for {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh}, and that he was taken to a hideout in the sewers. If the characters didn't learn from the kenku where Floon was taken, asking questions of the locals can reveal that many people saw him being dragged off. A successful {@dc 15} Intelligence (Investigation) check or 5 gp in bribes allows the characters to trace the kidnappers' path through back alleys to a circular metal cover inset in the pavement. The cover is easily lifted, revealing a ladder down into the sewers.
data/2/entries/6/entries/0.zh_tw: 此時，角色們很可能已經知道福盧恩被誤認為是 {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼} 而被姍娜薩公會成員綁架，並被帶到了下水道的一個藏身處。如果角色們沒有從肯庫那裡得知福盧恩被帶往何處，向當地人詢問可能會發現許多人看到他被拖走。一次成功的 {@dc 15} 智力（調查）檢定或 5 金幣的賄賂可以讓角色們追蹤綁架者的路徑，透過後巷來到一個嵌入路面的圓形金屬蓋。蓋子很容易被抬起，露出一段通往下水道的梯子。
data/2/entries/6/entries/0.reason: Xanathar Guild, not Zhentarim, commits this attack

data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/34/en.english: {@creature Bepis Honeymaker|wdh} is a honey merchant who was kidnapped from his Trades Ward home a month ago. The Xanathar Guild tried to ransom him back, but seemingly his relatives either couldn't pay or decided not to. (In truth, his rotten in-laws destroyed the ransom notes and told Bepis' wife and children that he ran away with another family.) {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} has put him to work as a cook but threatens to give him over to the mind flayer {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} every so often.
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/34/en.zh_tw: {@creature Bepis Honeymaker|wdh|貝皮斯·蜜釀師}是一名蜂蜜商人，一個月前在商業區的家中遭到綁架。姍娜薩公會曾向他的家人勒索贖金，但他的親屬似乎不是付不出來，就是決定不付。（實際上，他那些惡劣的姻親銷毀了勒贖信，並告訴貝皮斯的妻兒，他拋下他們，跟另一個家庭跑了。）{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}讓他當廚師，卻不時威脅要把他交給奪心魔{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}。
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/34/en.reason: Xanathar Guild demands ransom; restore family deception and threatened mind flayer

data/5/entries/11/entries/4/entries/2/it.english: The courthouse magister is {@creature Hester Barch|WDH} (LG female Turami human {@creature acolyte} with Insight +4), a petite woman in her seventies. Magister Barch is slow to anger and fond of sharing lengthy educational anecdotes and parables. Unknown to all but her closest aides, the magister has the innate psionic ability to cast the {@spell detect thoughts} spell without somatic or material components. After using it once, the magister must finish a short or long rest before she can cast the spell again. Wisdom is her spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}).
data/5/entries/11/entries/4/entries/2/it.zh_tw: 法院官員是赫絲特·巴奇（{@creature Hester Barch|WDH|赫絲特·巴奇}）（守序善良的圖拉米人類女性{@creature acolyte||侍僧}，洞悉+4），一個七十多歲的小個子女性。巴奇法官不易動怒，喜歡分享冗長的教育軼事和寓言。除了她最親密的助手外，沒有人知道法官天生具有心靈能力，可以在無需姿勢或材料成分的情況下施展{@spell detect thoughts||偵測思想}法術。使用一次後，法官必須完成一次短休或長休才能再次施展該法術。感知是她的施法關鍵屬性（法術豁免{@dc 12}）。
data/5/entries/11/entries/4/entries/2/it.reason: Wisdom spellcasting ability and Insight proficiency use site rule terms

data/2/entries/3/entries/4/entries/4/ent.english: The shopkeeper is a wizened {@creature deep gnome (svirfneblin)||deep gnome} who spies for the Xanathar Guild. A few years ago, he survived the detonation of a gas spore in Undermountain and inherited some stray beholder memories. Driven by a compulsion to carve out his own domain, the gnome settled in Waterdeep, bought the Old Xoblob Shop from its previous owner, and tried renaming it after himself, yet everyone kept calling it the Old Xoblob Shop. He therefore restored the old name and changed his name to Xoblob. "No relation to the eye tyrant hanging in the window!" he says.
data/2/entries/3/entries/4/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 店主是一個老練的{@creature deep gnome (svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}，為姍娜薩公會做間諜。幾年前，他在地脈迷城的一次氣孢爆炸中倖存下來，並繼承了一些零散的眼魔記憶。出於建立自己領地的衝動，這個侏儒在深水城定居，從前任店主那裡買下了老索布洛布商店，並試圖以自己的名字重新命名它，但每個人都繼續叫它老索布洛布商店。因此，他恢復了舊名字，並將名字改為索布洛布。"和櫥窗裡掛著的眼魔暴君沒有關係！"他說。

data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/2/ent.english: Characters are most likely to enter {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair by this route: a spiral staircase accessible from the Castle Ward's sewers and hidden behind a secret door. This staircase circumvents a more difficult route through Undermountain and Skullport, which is described in {@i Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage}.
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 角色們最有可能透過這種方式進入{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴：從城堡區的下水道可進入的螺旋樓梯，隱藏在一扇密門後面。這條樓梯繞過了透過地脈迷城和骷髏港的更加困難的路線，後者在{@i 深水城: 瘋法師的地城}中有描述。

data/9/entries/1.english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH} yearns to rule Waterdeep as a tyrant, take over the Zhentarim, and use both seats of power to plunder and control the Sword Coast. He needs the gold in the Vault of Dragons to pay off Masked Lords and Zhentarim leaders whose support will be instrumental when the time comes to oust Lady {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} as Open Lord. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} has a long list of powerful enemies, among them the Harpers, Elminster of Shadowdale, Halaster Blackcloak of Undermountain, and the Blackstaff of Waterdeep. These enemies would quickly move against {@creature Manshoon|WDH} if they learned he was hiding in Waterdeep. For his evil plans to succeed, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} must operate in the shadows for the time being.
data/9/entries/1.zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}渴望作為暴君統治深水城，掌控散塔林會，並利用這兩個權力位置來掠奪和控制劍灣。他需要龍之寶庫中的黃金來收買那些在時機成熟時推翻{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}作為公開領主的蒙面領主和散塔林會領袖。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}有一長串強大的敵人，其中包括豎琴手聯盟、陰影谷的伊爾明斯特、地脈迷城的海拉斯特·黑斗篷以及深水城的黑杖。這些敵人如果得知{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}潛藏在深水城，將立即採取行動對付他。為了實現他的邪惡計劃，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}目前必須隱藏在暗處。

data/10/entries/5/entries/11/entries/4/e.english: Beneath the plateau of Waterdeep lies the largest and deepest dungeon in the world. It sprawls out under the city, said to plunge as many as twenty levels deep. The Melairkyn dwarves first excavated the tunnels that would become Undermountain, and the drow are said to have dug their own tunnels up from below. All were claimed, altered, and expanded by the mad wizard Halaster and his apprentices-who are believed to dwell in the dungeons to this day. What drove them deep into the earth remains a mystery, but Undermountain's allure is a siren song that still draws many. If you want to see adventurers descend into the depths, or perhaps glimpse some returning with wondrous treasures, visit the Yawning Portal in the Castle Ward.
data/10/entries/5/entries/11/entries/4/e.zh_tw: 在深水城高原之下，坐落著世界上最大的、最深的地牢。它在城市下方蔓延，據說深入地下多達二十層。梅拉金矮人最初挖掘了這些將成為地脈迷城的隧道，而卓爾據說從下方挖掘了自己的隧道。所有這些都被瘋狂的法師海拉斯特和他的學徒們聲稱、改變和擴建——他們被認為至今仍然居住在地牢中。是什麼驅使他們深入地下仍然是個謎，但地脈迷城的誘惑就像海妖的歌聲，仍然吸引著許多人。如果你想看到冒險家們深入地下，或者可能一睹一些帶著奇妙寶藏返回的人，可以訪問城堡區的呵欠之門。

data/12/entries/20/entries/4.english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH} aims to rule Waterdeep and replace the City Watch with Black Network mercenaries that are loyal to him alone. By bribing and blackmailing the Masked Lords, he hopes to oust {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} as Open Lord and take her place, kill the Blackstaff, reduce the Masked Lords to mere vassals, and declare himself the Wizard-King of Waterdeep. Once the city is firmly in his clutches, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} will then turn his attention toward Undermountain, destroy Halaster once and for all, and claim the dungeon's riches.
data/12/entries/20/entries/4.zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 企圖統治深水城，用只忠於他自己的黑網僱傭兵取代城市守衛。透過賄賂和勒索蒙面領主，他希望驅逐 {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手} 作為公開領主並取代她的位置，殺死黑杖，將蒙面領主降為僅僅是封臣，並自封為深水城的法師王。一旦城市牢牢掌握在他手中，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 將轉向地脈迷城，徹底摧毀海拉斯特，並宣稱地牢的財富。

data/12/entries/22/entries/2.english: The intellect devourer that inhabits Meloon's skull was bred by {@creature Nihiloor|WDH}, a mind flayer in {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s employ. It knows everything Meloon knew, and Meloon behaves much as he did before his descent into Undermountain. He hangs out at the Yawning Portal, tries to bond with adventurers, and offers a helping hand whenever doing so feels appropriate. The intellect devourer's primary goals are to steer adventurers away from Undermountain and get them to undertake quests that further the aims of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}. Such quests usually involve the eradication of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s enemies, and Meloon is all too eager to fight alongside those who fall for his ruse.
data/12/entries/22/entries/2.zh_tw: 佔據麥倫頭骨的噬腦怪是由{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}培育的，尼希盧爾是{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}僱傭的奪心魔。它知道麥倫所知道的一切，麥倫的行為和他進入地脈迷城之前的行為非常相似。他常去呵欠之門，試圖與冒險家建立聯絡，並在適當的時候提供幫助。噬腦怪的主要目標是引導冒險家遠離地脈迷城，並讓他們執行進一步實現{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}目的的任務。這樣的任務通常涉及根除{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的敵人，而麥倫非常渴望與那些落入他的圈套的人並肩戰鬥。

data/10/entries/4/entries/8/entries/5/en.english: Most Waterdavians are also slow to take fright unless facing magic or monsters. A swaggering warrior threatening them is quite likely to be stared at calmly, or even sneered at. "The only mortals that Waterdavians fear are a few unstable wizards and the Lords," {@creature Durnan|WDH} often says to those who are surprised by the nonchalance of the Yawning Portal's regulars concerning the open entrance to Undermountain in their midst. "And only when they've incurred the wrath of said persons themselves."
data/10/entries/4/entries/8/entries/5/en.zh_tw: 大多數深水城居民除非面對魔法或怪物，否則不太容易感到害怕。一個傲慢的戰士威脅他們時，很可能會被冷靜地注視，甚至被嘲笑。"深水城居民唯一懼怕的凡人是一些不穩定的巫師和領主們，" {@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南} 經常對那些對地脈迷城的開放入口表現得漠不關心的呵欠之門常客們感到驚訝的人說道。"而且只有當他們自己激怒了這些人時。"

data/8/entries/5/entries/2/entries/6/ent.english: Your predecessor left the City of Splendors in a sorry state, but you have done wonders to lift the spirit of the citizenry during your short time in office. I know how politics offends you, so forgive me for taking this opportunity to point out the obvious. We can make both our cities stronger and strike back at he who robbed Waterdavians of their wealth and dignity. I'm speaking, of course, of that dirty sack of rats, Dagult Neverember. That's the phrase you used to describe him yesterday to the emissary from Mirabar, is it not? Evidently, my spies are also to be commended!
data/8/entries/5/entries/2/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 你的前任讓輝煌之城陷入了一個可悲的狀態，但在你短暫的任期內，你已經奇蹟般地提振了市民的精神。我知道政治讓你感到不快，所以請原諒我藉此機會指出顯而易見的事實。我們可以使我們的兩個城市變得更強大，並且反擊那個剝奪了深水城居民財富和尊嚴的人。我當然指的是那個骯髒的老鼠袋，達格魯特·奈弗梅伯。這是你昨天對來自米拉巴的使者描述他的話，不是嗎？顯然，我的間諜們也值得稱讚！

data/10/entries/5/entries/4/entries/0.english: The Sea Ward stands proud on the high ground above Mount Waterdeep's sunset shadow. The rich and the powerful (or those who wish you to think such of them, and can afford the rent) reside or run their businesses here. When the warlords and pirates of early Waters Deep gained enough gold, they built fortresses on what used to be fields of grass tousled by sea wind. You can still see the remains of some of those old castles incorporated into the palatial homes of the noble families that dwell in the Sea Ward. For the best all-around view of the glittering homes enshrouded by garden walls, go to where Diamond Street and Delzorin Street cross, nigh to Mystra's House of Wonder, and simply spin in a circle.
data/10/entries/5/entries/4/entries/0.zh_tw: 海區自豪地坐落在深水城山日落陰影的高地上。富人和有權勢的人（或者那些希望你這樣認為的人，並且能付得起租金的人）在這裡居住或經營他們的業務。當早期深水城的軍閥和海盜獲得足夠的金幣時，他們在曾經被海風吹拂的草地上建造了堡壘。你仍然可以看到一些那些古老城堡的遺蹟被納入居住在海區的貴族家族的豪華住宅中。要想獲得被花園牆環繞的閃閃發光的房屋的最佳全景，可以去鑽石街和德爾佐林街交匯處，靠近密斯特拉的奇蹟之屋，然後簡單地轉一圈。

data/10/entries/5/entries/7/entries/3.english: Magic users should be wary in the Court of the White Bull. Long ago, this plaza was a grazing area for livestock, including an albino calf that was born here. The calf's owner built the White Bull Tavern, which thrived on the spot for years and gave the area its name. You'll not find the tavern now, though. It vanished, utterly destroyed during an infamous spell battle between the archmage Thongalar the Mighty and the evil mage Shile Rauretilar and his apprentices. In the storm of magic that touched down here, Shile and his apprentices all perished and the fabric of the Weave was rent, such that Azuth, god of wizards, was forced to appear and set things right. He is said to have stitched reality and the Weave back together, but a wrinkle in the fabric remains. To this day, magic brought to bear in the Court of the White Bull sometimes goes awry, and the use of magic items and spells is forbidden in the area.
data/10/entries/5/entries/7/entries/3.zh_tw: 在白牛廣場，魔法使用者應該小心謹慎。很久以前，這個廣場是一個放牧區，包括一隻在這裡出生的白化小牛。小牛的主人建造了白牛旅館，旅館在這個地方繁榮了多年，並給了這個地區它的名字。不過，現在你找不到旅館了。它消失了，在強大的法師松加拉爾和邪惡法師希萊·勞雷提拉爾及其學徒之間的一場臭名昭著的法術戰鬥中被徹底摧毀。在這裡降臨的魔法風暴中，希萊和他的學徒都喪生了，魔網的結構被撕裂，以至於法師之神阿祖斯不得不出現並糾正事情。據說他將現實和魔網重新縫合，但布料上留下了一個褶皺。直到今天，在白牛廣場使用的魔法有時會出錯，該區域禁止使用魔法物品和咒語。

data/10/entries/5/entries/6/entries/1.english: Castle Waterdeep stands above the city on a great bluff that extends out from the mountain, its towers soaring hundreds of feet into the sky. It surprises many to learn that this isn't where Waterdeep's rulers reside, nor from where the city is governed. The castle was and is a redoubt of last defense should the city be attacked, but for well over a century, the ruler of Waterdeep has occupied the Palace of Waterdeep-also known as Piergeiron's Palace, and still called that by elderly and long-lived citizens (including many elves).
data/10/entries/5/entries/6/entries/1.zh_tw: 深水堡矗立於城市上方一處從山脈延伸出的巨大陡崖上，其塔樓高聳入雲達數百尺。許多人驚訝地發現這裡既非深水城統治者的居所，也非城市管理中樞。這座城堡過去與現在都是城市遇襲時的最後防線，而一個多世紀以來，深水城的統治者始終坐鎮於深水宮——也被稱為皮爾蓋倫宮，長壽市民（包括許多精靈）至今仍沿用這個舊稱。

data/5/entries/2/entries/2/entries/0.english: If the characters can't pick up the trail after the {@creature nimblewright|wdh} escapes with the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, they might turn to the City Watch, the City Guard, or a friendly faction for help, which comes forth in {@dice 1d4} days. If it occurs to none of the characters, an NPC suggests that the party visit the House of Inspired Hands to see whether the priests of Gond know a way to find it (see "Nim's Secret"). Thereafter, armed with Nim's nimblewright detector, the characters can sweep the city. But by the time they find the nimblewright, it has already delivered the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} to its intended destination.
data/5/entries/2/entries/2/entries/0.zh_tw: 如果角色們在{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}帶著{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}逃跑後無法追蹤到線索，他們可能會轉向城防軍、城市守衛或友好派系尋求幫助，這將在{@dice 1d4}天內得到回應。如果角色們沒有想到這一點，一個NPC建議隊伍去拜訪啟迪之手之家，看看貢德的祭司是否知道找到它的方法（見"尼姆的秘密"）。之後，裝備了尼姆的靈巧生物探測器，角色們可以搜查整個城市。但當他們找到靈巧生物時，它已經將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}送到了預定的目的地。

data/12/entries/25/entries/1.english: The illithid {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} works for {@creature Xanathar|WDH}, spending its days creating intellect devourers and setting them loose in the sewers of Waterdeep. Each intellect devourer attacks the first humanoid it encounters, using its victim as a puppet to spy on the city and relay information back to {@creature Nihiloor|WDH}. Occasionally, an intellect devourer is instructed to seek out a particular kind of target, such as a member of the City Guard or the City Watch. Sometimes its instructions will include orders to capture specific Waterdavians and bring them to Skullport, where they can be enslaved or ransomed.
data/12/entries/25/entries/1.zh_tw: 奪心魔 {@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾} 為 {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 工作，整日製造噬腦怪並將其釋放到深水城的下水道中。每隻噬腦怪都會攻擊它遇到的第一個人形生物，並將其作為傀儡以監視城市並將資訊傳回 {@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}。偶爾，噬腦怪會被指示去尋找特定型別的目標，例如城防軍或城市守衛的成員。有時，它的指示中還會包括抓捕特定的深水城居民並將他們帶到骷髏港的任務，在那裡他們可能會被奴役或勒索贖金。

data/3/entries/4/entries/10/entries/4/en.english: Any character who spends at least three days asking pertinent questions and pursuing leads in the Southern Ward or the Dock Ward can, at the end of that time, make a {@dc 18} Charisma (Persuasion or Intimidation) check. On a success, the character convinces some tight-lipped halflings to arrange a meeting with Dasher. The meeting is scheduled to occur at highsun in Waymoot the next day. Dasher shows up to hear what the characters have to say, but he has no intention of going home. He recently joined a gang of halfling wererats called the Shard Shunners (so named because they detest silver) and has since become a wererat himself. The Shard Shunners are his family now. {@i Reward}: Each Zhentarim character gains 2 renown.
data/3/entries/4/entries/10/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 任何角色只要在南區或碼頭區花至少三天時間提問相關問題並追查線索，便可在該段時間結束時進行一個{@dc 18}魅力（說服或威嚇）檢定。若成功，該角色將說服一些寡言的半身人安排與達舍的會面。會面安排在隔天正午的路會廣場進行。達舍會出席聽取角色要說的話，但他無意回家。他最近加入了一個名為"避碎幫"的半身人狼鼠幫派（如此命名是因為他們憎惡銀器），並因此自己變成了狼鼠。避碎幫現在已是他的家人。{@i 獎勵}：每位散塔林會角色獲得2點聲望。

data/10/entries/6/entries/5/entries/20/e.english: This holy day pays tribute to Leira and Mask. To placate those deities and ward away their attention, folk of all walks of life don masks and costumes (magical or mundane) to disguise themselves and play at being other than what they are. Commonly seen mask styles include the black mask symbol of Mask and the mirror face of the priests of Leira. But there are no bounds on the disguise you don, and the more elaborate and outlandish it is, the more celebrated the wearer.
data/10/entries/6/entries/5/entries/20/e.zh_tw: 這個神聖的日子向蕾拉和麵具致敬。為了安撫這些神祇並避免引起他們的注意，各行各業的人們戴上面具和服裝（無論是魔法的還是普通的），偽裝自己，扮演與自己不同的身份。常見的面具風格包括面具的黑色面具象徵和蕾拉神職人員的鏡面臉。但是你的偽裝沒有界限，越精緻和離奇，佩戴者就越受慶祝。

data/5/entries/3/entries/6/entries/1/ent.english: The stone is delivered to {@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH}, a mage who has worked for {@creature Xanathar|WDH} in the past. When she refuses to give up the stone, members of the Xanathar Guild try to take it by force (encounter 2, "Mistshore"). After the characters defeat these attackers, they learn that Grinda told her rat familiar to hide the stone in her family's crypt in the City of the Dead. From this point on, the characters are followed by a gazer (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), through whose eyes {@creature Xanathar|WDH} can see. If this gazer is killed, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} doesn't send another one to replace it.
data/5/entries/3/entries/6/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 這塊石頭被送到了過去曾為{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}工作的法師{@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH|格林達·加洛斯}手中。當她拒絕交出石頭時，姍娜薩公會的成員試圖用武力奪取（遭遇2，'霧岸'）。在角色們擊敗這些攻擊者後，他們得知格林達告訴她的老鼠使魔將石頭藏在亡者之城的家族墓穴中。從這一點開始，角色們被一個凝視者眼魔跟蹤（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），透過它的眼睛{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}可以看到。如果這個凝視者眼魔被殺死，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}不會派出另一個來替代它。

data/5/entries/4/entries/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 當這次遭遇開始時，要麼角色們手中握有{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，這樣的話他們在穿過塔附近的小巷時會被伏擊——或者它被{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的凝視者眼魔間諜奪走了，在這種情況下他們會在小巷中追上凝視者眼魔，在這些生物能夠下到下水道之前。

data/5/entries/7/entries/4/entries/3/ent.english: As the characters leave the mausoleum, they are jumped by four {@creature duergar}, members of the Xanathar Guild, who slipped past the cemetery guards using their invisibility. The leader, Gorath, accosts the characters in Dwarvish, demands the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, and refuses to believe that they don't have it. If the stone isn't turned over to them promptly, the duergar enlarge themselves and attack. {@creature Xanathar|WDH} watches the battle unfold through the eyes of a gazer (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), which stays out of the fight and tries to remain unseen.
data/5/entries/7/entries/4/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 當角色們離開陵墓時，他們被四名{@creature duergar||灰矮人}伏擊，這些是姍娜薩公會的成員，他們利用隱形能力悄悄溜過了墓地守衛。領袖戈拉斯用矮人語質問角色們，要求交出{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，並且不相信他們沒有這塊石頭。如果石頭沒有立即交給他們，這些灰矮人會變大並發動攻擊。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}透過一個凝視者眼魔的視角觀察戰鬥的發展（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），凝視者眼魔不參與戰鬥並試圖保持隱蔽。

data/5/entries/14/entries/6/entries/4/en.english: The eyestalk need not come from a true, living beholder. It can be plucked from a stuffed beholder (see "Old Xoblob Shop") or obtained from a lesser form of beholderkin, such as a gazer or a spectator. The eyestalk also need not be detached. {@creature Xanathar|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) gladly accompanies characters to the vault if that's the way to guarantee getting its share of the treasure. Regardless of the arrangement it makes with the characters, "its share" equates to all the treasure. In other words, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} turns on the party once the vault is unlocked, unless a powerful NPC (such as {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} or {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH}) is present to keep the mad beholder in check.
data/5/entries/14/entries/6/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 眼梗不必來自一個真正的、活著的眼魔。它可以從填充的眼魔（見"老索布洛布商店"）上拔下來，或者從一個較低階的眼魔種類，如凝視者眼魔或觀察者眼魔那裡獲得。眼梗也不必是分離的。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）如果這樣能保證得到它的那份財寶，很樂意陪伴角色們去金庫。無論它與角色們達成什麼協議，"它的份額"等同於所有的財寶。換句話說，一旦金庫被解鎖，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}就會對隊伍翻臉，除非有一個強大的NPC（如{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}或{@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾}）在場來控制這個瘋狂的眼魔。

data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/14/en.english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} dreamed this gazer into existence and sent it to spy on Thorvin, whose loyalty the beholder is beginning to question. The gazer is itself disloyal. A wizard character can befriend it with a successful {@dc 11} Charisma (Persuasion) check and turn it into their familiar with a {@spell find familiar} ritual. When the gazer becomes a familiar, its alignment changes to match that of its new master.
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/14/en.zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 夢見了這隻凝視者眼魔並將其送到託文身邊進行監視，因為這個眼魔開始懷疑託文的忠誠。這隻凝視者眼魔本身也並不忠誠。一名法師角色可以透過成功的 {@dc 11} 魅力（說服）檢定與其成為朋友，並透過 {@spell find familiar||尋獲魔寵} 儀式將其轉化為自己的魔寵。當凝視者眼魔成為魔寵時，它的陣營會變更為與其新主人一致。

data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/14/en.english: The pulverizer is a pet project of Thorvin's that allows him to hang around {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair and gather information, which he sells to the Harpers. (Thorvin puts the coin he earns from the faction in a bank, far from the beholder's prying eyes.) If one or more characters approach him and claim to be Harpers, Thorvin is upset that they would risk exposing him as a spy, pointing to the albino gazer. If the characters befriend the gazer and promise to go away, Thorvin truthfully answers as many as three questions. He's never seen {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH}'s chambers (areas X11 and X12) but knows the rest of the lair well.
data/6/entries/7/entries/4/entries/14/en.zh_tw: 粉碎機是索文的個人專案，它允許他待在{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴附近並收集資訊，這些資訊他將其賣給了豎琴手聯盟。（索文把他從派系那裡賺來的錢存入銀行，遠離了巨眼魔的窺探之眼。）如果有一或多個角色接近他並聲稱自己是豎琴手聯盟，索文會因為他們冒險暴露他是間諜而感到不安，他指向那個白化凝視者眼魔。如果角色們與凝視者眼魔成為朋友並承諾離開，索文會如實回答多達三個問題。他從未見過{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}的房間（X11和X12區域），但對巢穴的其他部分非常熟悉。

data/3/entries/4/entries/8/entries/1/ent.english: "The Zhents are courting a Red Wizard of Thay named Esloon Bezant, trying to add his gang of thugs to their ranks. All we know about him is that he fled his homeland a few years back and is too smart to get caught doing anything illegal. He and his gang of bullies prowl the Dock Ward. Scuttle the deal, and do it fast!"
data/3/entries/4/entries/8/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: "散塔林會正在拉攏一個名叫埃斯盧恩·貝贊特的賽爾紅袍法師，試圖將他的暴徒團夥納入他們的行列。我們所知道的關於他的資訊是，他幾年前逃離了自己的家鄉，並且非常聰明，沒有被抓到做任何違法的事情。他和他的惡霸團夥在碼頭區遊蕩。破壞這筆交易，並且要快！"

data/6/entries/1.english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has let its paranoia get the better of it, and the beholder trusts no one. The {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} disappeared from its lair while it was brokering a deal that would have merged the Xanathar Guild and the Zhentarim into a single criminal organization. Although the Zhents didn't steal the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} believes they did. Once content to merely possess the stone, the beholder is no longer confident of the gold's safety in the Vault of Dragons. {@creature Xanathar|WDH} thinks that the gold would be safer under its watchful gaze, but without the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, it can't remember where the gold is hidden.
data/6/entries/1.zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的偏執情緒已經佔據了上風，這個眼魔不再信任任何人。當它正在促成一項將姍娜薩公會和散塔林會合併為單一犯罪組織的交易時，{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}從它的巢穴中消失了。儘管散塔林會成員並沒有偷走{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，但{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}卻認為他們偷了。曾經滿足於僅僅擁有這塊石頭的眼魔，不再對龍之寶庫中黃金的安全性感到自信。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}認為在它的警惕目光下，黃金會更安全，但沒有了{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，它記不得黃金藏在哪裡了。

data/3/entries/4/entries/6/entries/3/ent.english: "A member of Force Grey has been acting strangely of late. His name is {@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH}, and his happy-go-lucky demeanor has soured. He's been hanging around the Yawning Portal more than usual. Observe him for a tenday, then report back to me."
data/3/entries/4/entries/6/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: "最近，灰色力量的一名成員表現得有些奇怪。他的名字是{@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH|麥倫·戰龍}，他那無憂無慮的性格已經變得陰沉。他比平時更多地在呵欠之門周圍徘徊。觀察他十天，然後向我彙報。"

data/10/entries/6/entries/5/entries/0.english: At many times of year, hardly a tenday can pass in Waterdeep without the staging of some rite, race, or rousing ceremony of civic pride. Here I briefly summarize the most widely celebrated events on the calendar, from the first of Hammer to the last of Nightal.
data/10/entries/6/entries/5/entries/0.zh_tw: 在一年中的許多時候，在深水城幾乎每十天就會有一次儀式、比賽或激動人心的公民自豪感慶典。在這裡，我簡要概述了從哈默月的第一天到奈塔爾月的最後一天日曆上最廣泛慶祝的事件。

data/10/entries/5/entries/11/entries/3/e.english: This area of rolling grassland and small wooded areas east of the city is a rural community focused on farming and animal husbandry, and which caters to travelers. It is also the site of a large and well-protected training camp for the City Guard, and a prison farm run by the City Watch (called Amendsfarm) where those convicted of minor offenses work off their debt to the city. Many gnomes and halflings live in this region, and most buildings are built to reflect their stature.
data/10/entries/5/entries/11/entries/3/e.zh_tw: 這個城市東側的這片起伏的草原和小型林地是一個以農業和畜牧業為主的鄉村社群，併為旅行者提供服務。它還是城防軍的一個大型且保護良好的訓練營地，以及由城市守衛經營的監獄農場（稱為贖罪農場），那些犯有輕微罪行的人在這裡為城市工作以償還他們的債務。許多侏儒和半身人居住在這個地區，大多數建築物都是根據他們的體型建造的。
data/10/entries/5/entries/11/entries/3/e.reason: City Guard runs military camp, City Watch runs prison farm
